BH00014 (Unnamed)

Translated on 17 Qudrat 183 using GPT 6.1 Sol

1

بسم ربّنا الأقدس الأعظم العلیّ الأبهی

Bi-smi Rabbinā al-Aqdas al-Aʿẓam al-ʿAliyy al-Abhā.

In the name of our Lord, the Most Holy, the Most Great, the Most Exalted, the All-Glorious.

2

للّه الحمد حمداً یمطر به السّحاب و یجد المقرّبون عرف قمیص ربّنا الوهّاب حمداً به قصد العشّاق منظر اللّه مالک المیثاق حمداً سرع به المخلصون الی مقام المکاشفة و اللّقآء و الموحّدون الی الذّورة العلیا حمداً به جرت الأنهار و اثمرّت الأشجار اشهد انّه لا اله الّا هو وحده لا شریک له التّکبیر و البهآء و الذّکر و الثّنآء علی اولیائه و اصفیائه الّذین ما اخذتهم فی اللّه لومة لائم و ما منعتهم سطوة ظالم و ما خوّفتهم ضوضآء جاهل اولئک عباد مکرمون لا خوف علیهم و لا هم یحزنون

Li-llāh al-ḥamd, ḥamdan yumṭiru bihi al-saḥāb wa-yajidu al-muqarrabūn ʿarfa qamīṣi Rabbinā al-Wahhāb; ḥamdan bihi qaṣada al-ʿushshāq manẓara Allāh Mālik al-Mīthāq; ḥamdan saraʿa bihi al-mukhliṣūn ilā maqām al-mukāshafa wa-al-liqāʾ wa-al-muwaḥḥidūn ilā al-dhirwa al-ʿulyā; ḥamdan bihi jarat al-anhār wa-athmarat al-ashjār. Ashhadu annahu lā ilāha illā Huwa waḥdahu lā sharīka lahu. Al-takbīr wa-al-bahāʾ wa-al-dhikr wa-al-thanāʾ ʿalā awliyāʾihi wa-aṣfiyāʾihi alladhīna mā akhadhathum fī Allāh lawmatu lāʾim wa-mā manaʿathum saṭwatu ẓālim wa-mā khawwafathum ḍawḍāʾu jāhil. Ulāʾika ʿibādun mukramūn, lā khawfun ʿalayhim wa-lā hum yaḥzanūn.

Praise be to God—a praise through which the clouds rain down and those brought near perceive the fragrance of the robe of our Lord, the All-Bountiful; a praise through which the lovers seek the countenance of God, the Lord of the Covenant; a praise through which the sincere hasten to the station of unveiling and reunion, and those who affirm His unity to the loftiest summit; a praise through which the rivers flow and the trees bear fruit. I testify that there is no God but Him, alone, without partner. Exaltation, glory, remembrance, and praise be upon His loved ones and His chosen ones, whom no blame from any blamer has deterred in the path of God, whom no tyrant’s might has held back, and whom no ignorant person’s clamor has frightened. They are honored servants; no fear will come upon them, nor will they grieve.

3

و بعد نامه‌های آنمحبوب فی‌الحقیقه بمثابهٴ امطار از سحاب محبّت مترادفاً متتابعاً هاطل انّ الخادم یشکر الّذی ایّدک و وفّقک و عرّفک و یسئله بأن یرفعک فی الملک و یعزّک بین عباده انّه علی کلّشیء قدیر

Va baʿd, nāmih-hā-yi ān maḥbūb fī al-ḥaqīqih bi-mathābiy-i amṭār az saḥāb-i maḥabbat mutarādifan mutatābiʿan hāṭil. Inna al-khādima yashkuru alladhī ayyadaka wa-waffaqaka wa-ʿarrafaka wa-yasʾaluhu bi-an yarfaʿaka fī al-mulk wa-yuʿizzaka bayna ʿibādihi, innahu ʿalā kulli shayʾin qadīr.

To proceed: your letters, beloved friend, have indeed been pouring down in succession, like rain from the clouds of love. This servant thanks Him who has strengthened you, granted you success, and bestowed recognition upon you, and asks Him to raise you up in the world and honor you among His servants. He is powerful over all things.

4

یک نامهٴ آنمحبوب که تاریخ آن ١٢ شهر صفر بود قلب را بنفحات سرور و چشم را بانوار محبّت مزیّن و منوّر فرمود صدهزار بار شکر مقصود عالمیانرا چه که توفیق عطا فرموده و مددش در هر آن میرسد والّا یرجع الوجود الی العدم و بعد از مشاهده و ملاحظه و قرائت قصد مقام اعلی و مقرّ اسمی الأسنی نموده بعد از اذن تلقاء وجه مالک اسماء عرض شد هذا ما نزّل فی الجواب قوله جلّ جلاله و عمّ نواله

Yik nāmiy-i ān maḥbūb kih tārīkh-i ān 12 shahr-i Ṣafar būd qalb rā bi-nafaḥāt-i surūr va chashm rā bi-anvār-i maḥabbat muzayyan va munavvar farmūd. Ṣad-hizār bār shukr-i Maqṣūd-i ʿālamiyān rā, chih kih tawfīq ʿaṭā farmūdih va madadash dar har ān mīrasad, va-illā yarjiʿu al-wujūdu ilā al-ʿadam. Va baʿd az mushāhidih va mulāḥiẓih va qirāʾat qaṣd-i maqām-i aʿlā va maqarr-i asmā al-asnā nimūdih, baʿd az idhn tilqāʾ-i vajh-i Mālik-i asmāʾ ʿarḍ shud. Hādhā mā nuzzila fī al-jawāb, qawluhu jalla jalāluhu wa-ʿamma nawāluhu:

One of your letters, beloved friend, dated the twelfth of the month of Ṣafar, adorned and illumined the heart with the breezes of joy and the eyes with the lights of love. A hundred thousand thanks to the Desire of all peoples, for He has granted success, and His assistance arrives at every moment; otherwise, existence would return to nothingness. After examining, considering, and reading it, I proceeded to the supreme station and the most exalted, most sublime abode. Once permission was given, it was presented before the face of the Lord of Names. This is what was revealed in reply—His words, exalted be His glory and all-embracing His bounty:

5

هو المشرق من افق البیان

Huwa al-Mushriq min ufuq al-bayān.

He is the One who shines from the horizon of utterance.

6

یا امین علیک بهائی و عنایتی و رحمتی الّتی سبقت من فی السّموات و الأرضین حمد کن مالک قدم را که ترا مؤیّد فرمود بر اقبال و ذکر و ثنا و خدمت امرش انّه عرّفک صراطه و هداک الی سبیله و وفّقک علی خدمة امره و رفعک الی مقام یذکرک القلم الأعلی من الأفق الأبهی المقام الّذی اقرّ الوری بعجزه عن ذکره ان افرح بهذا الفضل الأعظم و قل لک الحمد یا مقصود العالمین

Yā Amīn, ʿalayka bahāʾī wa-ʿināyatī wa-raḥmatī allatī sabaqat man fī al-samāwāt wa-al-araḍīn. Ḥamd kun Mālik-i qidam rā kih turā muʾayyad farmūd bar iqbāl va dhikr va thanā va khidmat-i amrash. Innahu ʿarrafaka ṣirāṭahu wa-hadāka ilā sabīlihi wa-waffaqaka ʿalā khidmati amrihi wa-rafaʿaka ilā maqāmin yadhkuruka al-Qalam al-Aʿlā min al-Ufuq al-Abhā, al-maqām alladhī aqarra al-warā bi-ʿajzihi ʿan dhikrihi. An ifraḥ bi-hādhā al-faḍl al-aʿẓam wa-qul laka al-ḥamdu yā Maqṣūd al-ʿālamīn.

O Amīn, upon you be My glory, My loving care, and My mercy, which has preceded all who are in the heavens and the earths. Praise the Lord of Eternity, who has strengthened you to turn toward Him, to remember and praise Him, and to serve His Cause. He has made His path known to you, guided you to His way, enabled you to serve His Cause, and raised you to a station in which the Most Exalted Pen remembers you from the All-Glorious Horizon—a station that all humanity has acknowledged its inability to describe. Rejoice in this most great bounty and say: “Praise be to You, O Desire of all peoples.”

7

یا امین در اکثری از الواح اولیا ذکر تو از قلم اعلی جاری و نازل طوبی لک و لمن هداک و اراک و اسمعک و ارشدک و الحمد لمن ایّدک و وفّقک علی عرفان من منع عن عرفانه اکثر العباد یشهد بذلک مالک الایجاد فی هذا المقام الرّفیع اولیای حقّ جلّ جلاله را تکبیر برسان و از قبل مظلوم ذکر نما تا بنار ذکر مشتعل شوند و بحکمت و بیان بتبلیغ امر رحمن مشغول گردند ناس بسیار غافلند اینمظلوم در جمیع احیان و اوان بأعلی البیان ایشان را بافق رحمن دعوت مینماید ولکن کل از سمع و بصر محرومند الّا من شآء اللّه چشمها را حجبات از مشاهده منع نموده و گوشها را قطن اوهام از اصغا بازداشته رحم اللّه العدل و الانصاف از این دو جز اسم نمانده نام موجود و رسم مفقود الأمر بید اللّه ربّ الغیب و الشّهود

Yā Amīn, dar aktharī az alvāḥ-i awliyā dhikr-i tu az Qalam-i Aʿlā jārī va nāzil. Ṭūbā laka wa-li-man hadāka wa-arāka wa-asmaʿaka wa-arshadaka, wa-al-ḥamdu li-man ayyadaka wa-waffaqaka ʿalā ʿirfāni man muniʿa ʿan ʿirfānihi aktharu al-ʿibād. Yashhadu bi-dhālika Mālik al-ījād fī hādhā al-maqām al-rafīʿ. Awliyā-yi Ḥaqq jalla jalāluhu rā takbīr birasān va az qibal-i Maẓlūm dhikr namā tā bi-nār-i dhikr mushtaʿil shavand va bi-ḥikmat va bayān bi-tablīgh-i Amr-i Raḥmān mashghūl gardand. Nās bisyār ghāfiland. Īn Maẓlūm dar jamīʿ-i aḥyān va avān bi-aʿlā al-bayān īshān rā bi-Ufuq-i Raḥmān daʿvat mīnamāyad, va-lākin kull az samʿ va baṣar maḥrūmand, illā man shāʾa Allāh. Chashm-hā rā ḥujubāt az mushāhidih manʿ nimūdih va gūsh-hā rā quṭn-i awhām az iṣghā bāz dāshtih. Raḥima Allāhu al-ʿadla wa-al-inṣāf. Az īn du juz ism namāndih, nām mawjūd va rasm mafqūd. Al-amru bi-yadi Allāh Rabb al-ghayb wa-al-shuhūd.

O Amīn, in most of the Tablets to the loved ones, mention of you has flowed and been revealed from the Most Exalted Pen. Blessed are you and He who has guided you, enabled you to see and hear, and directed you aright. Praise be to Him who has strengthened you and enabled you to recognize the One whom most people have been kept from recognizing. To this the Lord of creation bears witness in this exalted station. Convey greetings of exaltation to the loved ones of God, exalted be His glory, and remember them on behalf of the Wronged One, that they may be set ablaze with the fire of remembrance and engage, with wisdom and utterance, in teaching the Cause of the All-Merciful. The people are deeply heedless. At every time and moment, this Wronged One calls them, in the most exalted utterance, to the horizon of the All-Merciful; yet all are deprived of hearing and sight, except those whom God wills. Veils have kept their eyes from seeing, and the cotton of vain imaginings has stopped their ears from listening. May God have mercy on justice and fairness! Nothing but their names remains: the names exist, but their traces are lost. The matter rests in the hands of God, the Lord of the unseen and the seen.

8

یا امین بحر بیان امکان را احاطه نموده و ندآء اللّه از اعلی افق عالم مرتفع معذلک احدی آگاه نشده مگر معدودی ولکن بأسی نبوده و نیست عنقریب ظاهر شود آنچه در الواح از قلم اللّه جاری گشته انتهی

Yā Amīn, baḥr-i bayān imkān rā iḥāṭih nimūdih va nidāʾ-i Allāh az aʿlā ufuq-i ʿālam murtafiʿ. Maʿa-dhālik aḥadī āgāh nashudih magar maʿdūdī, va-lākin baʾsī nabūdih va nīst. ʿAn-qarīb ẓāhir shavad ānchih dar alvāḥ az Qalam-i Allāh jārī gashtih. Intahā.

O Amīn, the ocean of utterance has encompassed the world of being, and the call of God has risen from the highest horizon of the world. Nevertheless, no one has become aware of it except a few. Yet this has not been, and is not, a cause for concern. Soon what has flowed from the Pen of God in the Tablets will become manifest. End.

9

قد هطلت امطار رحمة ربّنا علیکم و علینا و اشرق نیّر کرمه امام وجوهنا من یقدر ان یذکره حقّ الذّکر او یصفه حقّ الوصف او یثنیه حقّ الثّنآء اتوب الیه و استغفره عمّا خطر ببالی و نطق به لسانی و حرّر به قلمی

Qad haṭalat amṭāru raḥmati Rabbinā ʿalaykum wa-ʿalaynā wa-ashraqa nayyiru karamihi amāma wujūhinā. Man yaqdiru an yadhkurahu ḥaqqa al-dhikr aw yaṣifahu ḥaqqa al-waṣf aw yuthniyahu ḥaqqa al-thanāʾ? Atūbu ilayhi wa-astaghfiruhu ʿammā khaṭara bi-bālī wa-naṭaqa bihi lisānī wa-ḥarrara bihi qalamī.

The rains of our Lord’s mercy have poured down upon you and upon us, and the sun of His generosity has shone before our faces. Who can remember Him as He deserves to be remembered, describe Him as He deserves to be described, or praise Him as He deserves to be praised? I turn to Him in repentance and ask His forgiveness for whatever has crossed my mind, been spoken by my tongue, or been written by my pen.

10

ذکر آنمحبوب لازال بوده از آیات مشرقات عنایات حقّ جلّ جلاله واضح و معلوم است صدهزار بار حمد و شکر که این ایّام نتیجهٴ کلمهٴ مبارکهٴ علیا که حین ورود خبر سجن حضرت اسم‌اللّه و من مع حضرته علیهم بهآء اللّه الأبهی بآن تکلّم فرمودند ظاهر و آشکار قوله تبارک و تعالی انّهم یستنصرون علینا بقوّة الجنود و المدافع و نحن نستنصر علیهم بالقویّ الغالب القدیر انتهی

Dhikr-i ān maḥbūb lā-zāl būdih, az āyāt-i mushriqāt-i ʿināyāt-i Ḥaqq jalla jalāluhu vāḍiḥ va maʿlūm ast. Ṣad-hizār bār ḥamd va shukr kih īn ayyām natījiy-i kalimiy-i mubārakiy-i ʿulyā kih ḥīn-i vurūd-i khabar-i sijn-i Ḥaḍrat-i Ismu’llāh va man maʿa ḥaḍratihi ʿalayhim Bahāʾ Allāh al-Abhā bi-ān takallum farmūdand ẓāhir va āshkār. Qawluhu tabāraka wa-taʿālā: Innahum yastanṣirūna ʿalaynā bi-quwwati al-junūd wa-al-madāfiʿ wa-naḥnu nastanṣiru ʿalayhim bi-al-Qawiyy al-Ghālib al-Qadīr. Intahā.

You have always been remembered, beloved friend, as is clear and evident from the shining verses of God’s loving care, exalted be His glory. A hundred thousand praises and thanks that, in these days, the outcome of the exalted, blessed words He spoke when news arrived of the imprisonment of the honored Ismu’llāh and those with him—upon them be the glory of God, the All-Glorious—is plain and manifest. His words, blessed and exalted is He: “They seek victory over Us through the strength of troops and cannons, while We seek victory over them through the Strong, the All-Subduing, the All-Powerful.” End.

11

آفاق عالم انسانی امروز بطراز جدید مزیّن و فائز دعای موحّدین و مخلصین و آملین و سائلین و قاصدین باستجابت مقرون کل خلاصی خواسته بودند از برای مسجونین و محبوسین مخصوص حضرت اسم‌اللّه علیه من کلّ بهآء ابهاه و من معه علیهم بهآء اللّه الأبهی الحمد للّه ظاهر شد آنچه سبب و علّت فرح و سرور است

Āfāq-i ʿālam-i insānī imrūz bi-ṭirāz-i jadīd muzayyan va fāʾiz. Duʿā-yi muvaḥḥidīn va mukhliṣīn va āmilīn va sāʾilīn va qāṣidīn bi-istijābat maqrūn. Kull khalāṣī khvāstih būdand az barā-yi masjūnīn va maḥbūsīn, makhṣūṣ Ḥaḍrat-i Ismu’llāh ʿalayhi min kulli bahāʾin abhāhu va man maʿahu ʿalayhim Bahāʾ Allāh al-Abhā. Al-ḥamdu li-llāh ẓāhir shud ānchih sabab va ʿillat-i faraḥ va surūr ast.

Today the horizons of the human world have been graced and adorned with a new splendor. The prayers of those who affirm God’s unity, the sincere, the hopeful, the suppliants, and the seekers have been answered. All had asked for the release of the imprisoned and the confined, especially the honored Ismu’llāh—upon him be the most glorious of all glory—and those with him—upon them be the glory of God, the All-Glorious. Praise be to God, what brings joy and gladness has come to pass.

12

یا حبیب فؤادی ناس غافلند اگر یک آن تفکّر نمایند مشاهده میکنند عدم بقای اعدا را و همچنین ظهورات قوّت و قدرت حقّ جلّ جلاله را مع سجن و حبس و صدهزار بلایای ظاهره مفسدین ارض صاد را اخذ فرمود اخذ عزیز مقتدر و نفسی متنبّه نشد و همچنین نفوس قاسیهٴ ارض طاء را از کاذب موسوم به صادق ثمّ الّذی قصد الرّزیّة الکبری لأهل البهآء حال هر دو بسقر مقرّ دارند معذلک بقدر سمّ ابره خلق بشعور نیامدند اینعبد اگر بخواهد از اینگونه امور ذکر نماید باید کتابی تألیف کند حیرت در سکر و غفلت خلق است آیا شعور چه شد و ادراک کجا رفت حیرت اندر حیرت است

Yā ḥabīb-i fuʾādī, nās ghāfiland. Agar yik ān tafakkur namāyand mushāhidih mīkunand ʿadam-i baqā-yi aʿdā rā va hamchunīn ẓuhūrāt-i quvvat va qudrat-i Ḥaqq jalla jalāluhu rā. Maʿa sijn va ḥabs va ṣad-hizār balāyā-yi ẓāhirih, mufsidīn-i arḍ-i Ṣād rā akhdh farmūd, akhdha ʿazīzin muqtadir, va nafsī mutanabbih nashud. Va hamchunīn nufūs-i qāsiyiy-i arḍ-i Ṭāʾ rā, az kādhib-i mawsūm bi-Ṣādiq, thumma alladhī qaṣada al-raziyyata al-kubrā li-ahl al-Bahāʾ. Ḥāl har du bi-Saqar maqarr dārand. Maʿa-dhālik bi-qadr-i samm-i ibrih khalq bi-shuʿūr nayāmadand. Īn ʿabd agar bikhvāhad az īn-gūnih umūr dhikr namāyad bāyad kitābī taʾlīf kunad. Ḥayrat dar sukr va ghaflat-i khalq ast. Āyā shuʿūr chih shud va idrāk kujā raft? Ḥayrat andar ḥayrat ast.

O beloved of my heart, the people are heedless. If they reflected for a single moment, they would see that the enemies do not endure, and would likewise see the manifestations of the strength and power of God, exalted be His glory. Despite imprisonment, confinement, and a hundred thousand outward afflictions, He seized the corruptors of the land of Ṣād with the grip of One mighty and all-powerful, yet not a soul took heed. Likewise He seized the hard-hearted souls of the land of Ṭāʾ, from the liar named Ṣādiq to the one who intended the greatest calamity for the people of Bahāʾ. Now both dwell in hellfire. Nevertheless, the people have not gained awareness even to the extent of a needle’s eye. If this servant wished to recount such matters, he would have to compose a book. What is astonishing is the people’s stupor and heedlessness. What has become of awareness, and where has understanding gone? It is bewilderment upon bewilderment.

13

فی‌الحقیقه در فقرهٴ ارض طاء باید تشکّر نمود علما که خود را پیشوا میدانند و خود را هادی و قائد میشمرند هر حین بنار عناد مشتعلند هر یوم شعله‌اش بیشتر و لهیبش واضحتر و ضرّش محکمتر هزار بار بر اهل بها هجوم نموده‌اند و هنوز بقدر ذرّه ضغینهٴ ایشان ساکن نشده و بغضا آرام نگرفته اگر یکی از آن نفوس خبیثه قدرت ظاهره مییافت و یا از امرا میشد آیا چه مینمود حال در پیشوایان خلق و حضرت سلطان تفکّر نمائید مع آنکه از این طائفه رضایتی نداشتند و اعدا هم نظر باظهار خدمت در لیالی و ایّام بمفتریات مشغول معذلک حضرت سلطان بصرافت طبع مبارک من غیر واسطه مسجونین را آزادی بخشید و از حبس نجات عنایت فرمود اگرچه مخلصین آنی از سجن و بلایای واردهٴ فی سبیل اللّه را بعالمی مبادله نمینمایند قسم بمربّی کونین هر آنی از سجن فی سبیل اللّه نعمتی است که از برای او شبه و مثل نبوده و نخواهد بود در هر حال باید انسان بعدل ناظر باشد و بانصاف تکلّم نماید از حقّ جلّ جلاله این خادم فانی سائل و آمل که در هر آن حضرت سلطان را مؤیّد دارد و موفّق فرماید انّه علی کلّشیء قدیر

Fī al-ḥaqīqih dar fiqriy-i arḍ-i Ṭāʾ bāyad tashakkur nimūd. ʿUlamā kih khud rā pīshvā mīdānand va khud rā hādī va qāʾid mīshumār and har ḥīn bi-nār-i ʿinād mushtaʿiland, har yawm shuʿlih-ash bīshtar va lahībash vāḍiḥtar va ḍarrash muḥkamtar. Hizār bār bar ahl-i Bahā hujūm nimūdih-and va hanūz bi-qadr-i dharrih ḍaghīniy-i īshān sākin nashudih va baghḍā ārām nagiriftih. Agar yikī az ān nufūs-i khabīthih qudrat-i ẓāhirih mīyāft va yā az umarā mīshud āyā chih mīnamūd? Ḥāl dar pīshvāyān-i khalq va Ḥaḍrat-i Sulṭān tafakkur namāyīd. Maʿa ānkih az īn ṭāʾifih riḍāyatī nadāshtand va aʿdā ham naẓar bi-iẓhār-i khidmat dar layālī va ayyām bi-muftariyāt mashghūl, maʿa-dhālik Ḥaḍrat-i Sulṭān bi-ṣirāfat-i ṭabʿ-i mubārak min ghayr-i vāsiṭih masjūnīn rā āzādī bakhshīd va az ḥabs najāt ʿināyat farmūd. Agarchih mukhliṣīn ānī az sijn va balāyā-yi vāridiy-i fī sabīl-i Allāh rā bi-ʿālamī mubādilih namīnamāyand. Qasam bi-Murabbī-yi kawnayn, har ānī az sijn fī sabīl-i Allāh niʿmatī ast kih az barā-yi ū shibh va mithl nabūdih va nakhvāhad būd. Dar har ḥāl bāyad insān bi-ʿadl nāẓir bāshad va bi-inṣāf takallum namāyad. Az Ḥaqq jalla jalāluhu īn khādim-i fānī sāʾil va āmil kih dar har ān Ḥaḍrat-i Sulṭān rā muʾayyad dārad va muvaffaq farmāyad. Innahu ʿalā kulli shayʾin qadīr.

In truth, one must offer thanks concerning the affair of the land of Ṭāʾ. The religious scholars, who regard themselves as leaders and count themselves as guides and commanders, are at every moment ablaze with the fire of hostility. Each day its flame grows greater, its blaze more apparent, and its harm more intense. They have attacked the people of Bahāʾ a thousand times, yet their rancor has not subsided in the slightest, nor has their hatred abated. If one of those wicked souls obtained temporal power or became a ruler, what would he do? Now reflect on the leaders of the people and His Majesty the Sovereign. Although he was not pleased with this community, and the enemies, seeking to display their service, were occupied night and day with fabrications, His Majesty the Sovereign nevertheless, of his own noble inclination and without an intermediary, granted the prisoners freedom and bestowed release from confinement. The sincere, however, would not exchange a single moment of imprisonment and affliction suffered in the path of God for an entire world. I swear by the Educator of both worlds: every moment of imprisonment in the path of God is a blessing that has never had, and will never have, a likeness or an equal. In every circumstance, one must regard matters with justice and speak with fairness. This passing servant asks and hopes of God, exalted be His glory, that He may strengthen His Majesty the Sovereign at every moment and grant him success. He is powerful over all things.

14

اینکه در بارهٴ الواح ابناء ناعق ارض کاف و را مرقوم داشتند در منظر اکبر تلقاء وجه مالک قدر عرض شد هذا ما نطق به لسان العظمة قوله جلّ و عزّ از قبل و بعد قرار بر این بود هر نفسی الواح بدیعهٴ منیعه طلب نماید از سماء فضل الهی نازل شاید غافلین آگاه شوند و نائمین بیدار و مصلحت آنرا از قبل بایادی امر در هر محلّی گذاشتیم و اذن دادیم بمقتضیات حکمت و مصلحت عمل نمایند تا حکم مشورت در عالم ثابت و راسخ شود انتهی

Īnkih dar bāriy-i alvāḥ-i abnā-yi nāʿiq-i arḍ-i Kāf va Rā marqūm dāshtand dar Manẓar-i Akbar tilqāʾ-i vajh-i Mālik-i qadar ʿarḍ shud. Hādhā mā naṭaqa bihi Lisān al-ʿAẓama, qawluhu jalla wa-ʿazza: Az qabl va baʿd qarār bar īn būd har nafsī alvāḥ-i badīʿiy-i manīʿih ṭalab namāyad az samāʾ-i faḍl-i ilāhī nāzil, shāyad ghāfilīn āgāh shavand va nāʾimīn bīdār. Va maṣlaḥat-i ān rā az qabl bi-Ayādī-yi Amr dar har maḥallī guzāshtīm va idhn dādīm bi-muqtaḍayāt-i ḥikmat va maṣlaḥat ʿamal namāyand tā ḥukm-i mashvarat dar ʿālam thābit va rāsikh shavad. Intahā.

What you wrote concerning Tablets for the sons of the clamorous one of the land of Kāf and Rā was presented in the Most Great Scene before the face of the Lord of destiny. This is what the Tongue of Grandeur spoke—His words, exalted and mighty is He: “The arrangement, before and since, has been that whenever anyone requests wondrous, exalted Tablets, they are revealed from the heaven of divine grace, so that perhaps the heedless may become aware and the sleeping may awaken. We previously left the decision as to its advisability to the Hands of the Cause in each locality, and gave them permission to act as wisdom and expediency require, so that the rule of consultation may become established and firmly rooted in the world.” End.

15

و فرمودند نعم ما عملا یعنی حضرت افنان و آنمحبوب لوحیکه مخصوص احبّای بهرام (اب) خواسته بودند در ساحت امنع اقدس اعلی عرض شد و این آیات باهرات از افق ارادهٴ مالک اسماء و صفات اشراق نمود قوله عزّ بیانه و جلّ برهانه

Va farmūdand: Niʿma mā ʿamilā. Yaʿnī Ḥaḍrat-i Afnān va ān maḥbūb. Lawḥī kih makhṣūṣ-i aḥibbā-yi Bahrām (ab) khvāstih būdand dar sāḥat-i amnaʿ-i aqdas-i aʿlā ʿarḍ shud va īn āyāt-i bāhirāt az ufuq-i irādiy-i Mālik-i asmāʾ va ṣifāt ishrāq nimūd. Qawluhu ʿazza bayānuhu wa-jalla burhānuhu:

And He said: “How well they have both acted!”—meaning the honored Afnān and you, beloved friend. The request for a Tablet specifically for the friends of Bahrām (AB) was presented in the most inaccessible, most holy, most exalted court, and these resplendent verses shone from the horizon of the will of the Lord of names and attributes. His words, mighty be His utterance and exalted His proof:

16

هو النّاطق العلیم الحکیم

Huwa al-Nāṭiq al-ʿAlīm al-Ḥakīm.

He is the Speaker, the All-Knowing, the All-Wise.

17

یا اهل بهرام یذکرکم مالک الأنام من شطر سجنه الأعظم و یدعوکم الیه انّه هو المهیمن علی ما یشآء و هو الفرد الواحد المقتدر العلیم الخبیر انّه اتی بملکوت الآیات و رایات البیّنات و النّاس اکثرهم من الغافلین قد ارتفع النّدآء و انجذبت به الأشیآء و القوم اکثرهم من الرّاقدین هذا یوم فیه قصد کلّ قاصد مقصود الأرض و السّمآء و کلّ منصف الأفق الأعلی و کلّ مخلص شطر محبوبه الأبهی طوبی لهذا الیوم و لمن عرفه و لمن قام علی خدمة امر اللّه العزیز الحمید انّا نوصیکم بالاستقامة علی هذا الأمر علی شأن لا یمنعکم نعاق الّذین کفروا باللّه و اعرضوا عن صراطه المستقیم و نوصیکم بذکر اللّه و ثنائه و التّوجّه الیه بقلوب نورآء و بما یرتفع به امره المحکم المتین انّ الأمین علیه بهائی ذکرکم ذکرناکم بالحقّ انّه هو الفضّال الغفور الکریم

Yā ahla Bahrām, yadhkurukum Mālik al-anām min shaṭri sijnihi al-aʿẓam wa-yadʿūkum ilayhi. Innahu Huwa al-Muhaymin ʿalā mā yashāʾ wa-Huwa al-Fard al-Wāḥid al-Muqtadir al-ʿAlīm al-Khabīr. Innahu atā bi-malakūt al-āyāt wa-rāyāt al-bayyināt wa-al-nāsu aktharuhum min al-ghāfilīn. Qad irtafaʿa al-nidāʾ wa-injadhabat bihi al-ashyāʾ wa-al-qawmu aktharuhum min al-rāqidīn. Hādhā yawmun fīhi qaṣada kullu qāṣidin Maqṣūda al-arḍ wa-al-samāʾ wa-kullu munṣifin al-Ufuqa al-Aʿlā wa-kullu mukhliṣin shaṭra Maḥbūbihi al-Abhā. Ṭūbā li-hādhā al-yawm wa-li-man ʿarafahu wa-li-man qāma ʿalā khidmati Amri Allāh al-ʿAzīz al-Ḥamīd. Innā nūṣīkum bi-al-istiqāmati ʿalā hādhā al-amr ʿalā shaʾnin lā yamnaʿukum nuʿāqu alladhīna kafarū bi-Allāh wa-aʿraḍū ʿan ṣirāṭihi al-mustaqīm. Wa-nūṣīkum bi-dhikri Allāh wa-thanāʾihi wa-al-tawajjuhi ilayhi bi-qulūbin nawrāʾ wa-bi-mā yartafiʿu bihi amruhu al-muḥkam al-matīn. Inna al-Amīn ʿalayhi bahāʾī dhakarakum dhakarnākum bi-al-ḥaqq. Innahu Huwa al-Faḍḍāl al-Ghafūr al-Karīm.

O people of Bahrām, the Lord of humanity remembers you from His Most Great Prison and calls you to Himself. He is the One who holds sway over whatever He wills, and He is the Unique, the One, the All-Powerful, the All-Knowing, the All-Informed. He has come with the kingdom of verses and the banners of clear proofs, yet most people are heedless. The call has been raised, and all things have been drawn to it, yet most people are asleep. This is a day on which every seeker has sought the Desire of earth and heaven, every fair-minded soul the Most Exalted Horizon, and every sincere soul the presence of his All-Glorious Beloved. Blessed is this day, and blessed are those who have recognized it and arisen to serve the Cause of God, the Almighty, the Praiseworthy. We exhort you to remain steadfast in this Cause, so that the clamor of those who have disbelieved in God and turned away from His straight path may not deter you. We exhort you to remember and praise God, to turn toward Him with radiant hearts, and to do whatever will exalt His firm and steadfast Cause. Amīn—upon him be My glory—has mentioned you, and We have remembered you in truth. He is indeed the Most Bountiful, the Ever-Forgiving, the Generous.

18

ای دوستان از قبل و بعد اهل مدن الهی را اخبار نمودیم بظهور ناعقین و انکار منکرین و مکرهای معتدین حال در بعضی از مدن آنچه را قلم اعلی بآن اخبار نموده ظاهر و باهر و بصدهزار حیله و مکر در اضلال نفوس مشغولند

Ey dūstān, az qabl va baʿd ahl-e modon-e elāhī rā ekh bār namūdīm be ẓohūr-e nāʿeqīn va enkār-e monkerīn va makr-hā-ye moʿtadīn. Ḥāl dar baʿḍī az modon ānche rā Qalam-e Aʿlā be ān ekh bār namūde ẓāher va bāher va be ṣad-hezār ḥīle va makr dar eḍlāl-e nofūs mashghūland.

O friends, time and again We informed the inhabitants of the divine cities of the emergence of clamorous voices, the denial of the deniers, and the schemes of the transgressors. Now, in some cities, what the Most Exalted Pen foretold is manifest and evident, and they are busy leading souls astray through a hundred thousand tricks and schemes.

19

نفوسیکه از اشراقات انوار آفتاب حقیقت منوّرند و از کوثر معانی و سلسبیل بیان نوشیده‌اند باستقامتی فائزند که جمیع اهل عالم قادر بر منع نبوده و نیستند طوبی از برای نفسیکه بحبل عنایت تمسّک نمود و بذیل فضل الهی تشبّث

Nofūsī ke az eshrāqāt-e anvār-e Āftāb-e Ḥaqīqat monavvarand va az Kawthar-e maʿānī va Salsabīl-e bayān nūshīde-and be esteqāmatī fāʾezand ke jamīʿ-e ahl-e ʿālam qāder bar manʿ nabūde va nīstand. Ṭūbā az barā-ye nafsī ke be ḥabl-e ʿenāyat tamassok namūd va be dheyl-e faḍl-e elāhī tashabboth.

Those souls who are illumined by the radiance of the Sun of Truth and have drunk from the Kawthar of meanings and the Salsabīl of utterance have attained a steadfastness that all the peoples of the world have never been, and are not now, able to overcome. Blessed is the soul who has held fast to the cord of loving-kindness and clung to the hem of divine grace.

20

هزار و دویست سال علمای آنجهات و فقهای اطراف ناس را بحضرت قائم دعوت مینمودند و بکمال اشتیاق از مالک آفاق لقائش را میطلبیدند و بعد از جهد و طلب و اشتیاق و انتظار ظهورش را انکار کردند و بظلم تمام آن سدرهٴ مبارکهٴ لاشرقیّه و لاغربیّه را قطع نمودند الا لعنة اللّه علی القوم الظّالمین

Hezār va devīst sāl ʿolamā-ye ān jahāt va foqahā-ye aṭrāf nās rā be Ḥaḍrat-e Qāʾem daʿvat mīnamūdand va be kamāl-e eshtiyāq az Mālek-e Āfāq leqāyash rā mīṭalabīdand va baʿd az jahd va ṭalab va eshtiyāq va enteẓār ẓohūrash rā enkār kardand va be ẓolm-e tamām ān Sedre-ye mobārake-ye lā-sharqiyye va lā-gharbiyye rā qaṭʿ namūdand. A-lā laʿnatu Allāhi ʿalā al-qawmi al-ẓālimīn.

For twelve hundred years, the learned of those regions and the jurists of the surrounding lands called the people to the Qāʾim and, with the utmost longing, implored the Lord of all horizons to grant them reunion with Him. Yet after all their striving, seeking, longing, and waiting, they denied His appearance and, with utter cruelty, cut down that blessed Tree, neither of the East nor of the West. Surely, the curse of God rests upon the people who do wrong.

21

حال هم از همان نفوس در اضلال خلق کمر شقاوت را محکم بسته‌اند یا حزب اللّه بحکمت و بیان بر خدمت امر قیام نمائید قیامیکه از اریاح نفاق حرکت ننماید و نلغزد قدر ایّام را بدانید و بما ینبغی مشغول گردید امروز را مثل و شبهی نبوده و نیست در کتب الهی بیوم اللّه معروف است کرسیّ ربّ جلّ جلاله بر بقعهٴ بیضا مقرّ یافته

Ḥāl ham az hamān nofūs dar eḍlāl-e khalq kamar-e shaqāvat rā moḥkam baste-and. Yā ḥizba Allāh, be ḥekmat va bayān bar khedmat-e Amr qiyām namāyīd, qiyāmī ke az aryāḥ-e nefāq ḥarakat nanamāyad va nalaghzad. Qadr-e ayyām rā bedānīd va be mā yanbaghī mashghūl gardīd. Emrūz rā methl va shabahī nabūde va nīst. Dar kotob-e elāhī be Yawmu Allāh maʿrūf ast. Korsī-ye Rabb, jalla jalāluhu, bar boqʿe-ye beyḍā ma qarr yāfte.

Even now, some of those same souls have firmly girded themselves for wickedness in leading people astray. O people of God, arise to serve the Cause with wisdom and utterance, with such resolve that the winds of dissension can neither shake it nor cause it to falter. Appreciate the worth of these days and occupy yourselves with what is fitting. This day has never had, and does not have, an equal or a likeness. In the divine Books it is known as the Day of God. The throne of the Lord, exalted be His glory, has been established upon the white Spot.

22

بقلوب نورا و وجوه بیضا بذکر مولی الوری مشغول باشید و از عالم و ما فیه فارغ و آزاد از حقّ جلّ جلاله میطلبیم شما را از بحر ظهور محروم نسازد و از آفتاب عنایت منع ننماید و جمیع را مؤیّد فرماید بر امریکه بدوام ملک و ملکوت پاینده و باقی باشد اوست بر هر شیء قادر و توانا انتهی

Be qolūb-e nowrā va vojūh-e beyḍā be dhekr-e Mawlā-ye Varā mashghūl bāshīd va az ʿālam va mā fīh fāregh va āzād. Az Ḥaqq, jalla jalāluhu, mīṭalabīm shomā rā az baḥr-e ẓohūr maḥrūm nasāzad va az āftāb-e ʿenāyat manʿ nanamāyad va jamīʿ rā moʾayyad farmāyad bar amrī ke be davām-e molk va malakūt pāyande va bāqī bāshad. Ūst bar har sheyʾ qāder va tavānā. Entahā.

With luminous hearts and radiant faces, occupy yourselves with the remembrance of the Lord of humanity, detached and free from the world and all that is in it. We ask God, exalted be His glory, not to deprive you of the ocean of Revelation or keep you from the sun of loving-kindness, and to assist everyone in a deed that will endure and remain as long as the earthly and heavenly kingdoms endure. He has power and might over all things. End.

23

اینفانی از حقّ جلّ جلاله میطلبد ابصار را بینائی جدید عطا فرماید و آذان را قوّت اصغاء تازه بخشد تا بچشم جدید و گوش تازه آیات الهی را بشنوند و بیّناتش را ببینند الیوم اعدای حقّ یعنی نفوسیکه خود را از اهل بیان میشمرند و سبب و علّت اضلال عبادند آن نفوس بهر لباسی درآیند و بهر صورتی ظاهر بعضی بعمّامه و عصا و ردا و زهد و تقوی و برخی بکمال محبّت و مودّت و گروهی باسبابهای دیگر در صدد عباد اللّه بیچاره افتاده‌اند

Īn fānī az Ḥaqq, jalla jalāluhu, mīṭalabad abṣār rā bīnāʾī-ye jadīd ʿaṭā farmāyad va ādhān rā qovvat-e eṣghā-ye tāze bakhshad tā be chashm-e jadīd va gūsh-e tāze āyāt-e elāhī rā beshnavand va bayyenā tash rā bebīnand. Al-yawm aʿdā-ye Ḥaqq, yaʿnī nofūsī ke khod rā az ahl-e Bayān mīshomorand va sabab va ʿellat-e eḍlāl-e ʿebādand, ān nofūs be har lebāsī darāyand va be har ṣūratī ẓāher, baʿḍī be ʿammāme va ʿaṣā va radā va zohd va taqvā va barkhī be kamāl-e maḥabbat va mavaddat va gorūhī be asbāb-hā-ye dīgar dar ṣadad-e ʿebād Allāh-e bīchāre oftāde-and.

This evanescent one asks God, exalted be His glory, to grant eyes a new vision and bestow upon ears a fresh power of listening, so that, with new eyes and fresh ears, they may hear the divine verses and behold His clear proofs. Today the enemies of God—that is, those who count themselves among the people of the Bayān and are the cause of His servants being led astray—assume every guise and appear in every form. Some, with turban, staff, robe, asceticism, and piety; others, with the utmost love and affection; and still others, by other means, have set themselves upon the helpless servants of God.

24

جمیع علمای ایران مگر قلیلی با آن زهد و تقواها و موعظه‌ها و ریاضتها فتوی بر قتل سیّد عالم روح من فی ملکوت الأمر و الخلق فداه دادند میدان آذربایجان شاهد و گواه و از ورای آن هر ذی بصر و سمعی و از ورای کل حقّ جلّ جلاله باری بفتوای آن نفوس ظالمه آن طلعة احدیّه را آویختند و شهید نمودند حالهم از همان قبیل بعضی بوساوس خنّاسیّه و خدعه‌های شیطانیّه پیدا شده‌اند قاتلهم اللّه و اعاذنا اللّه و ایّاکم من شرّ هؤلآء

Jamīʿ-e ʿolamā-ye Īrān magar qalīlī bā ān zohd va taqvā-hā va mowʿeẓe-hā va riyāḍat-hā fatvā bar qatl-e Seyyed-e ʿĀlam, rūḥu man fī malakūti al-amri wa-al-khalqi fidāh, dādand. Meydān-e Ādharbāyjān shāhed va govāh va az varā-ye ān har dhī baṣar va samʿī va az varā-ye koll Ḥaqq, jalla jalāluhu. Bārī be fatvā-ye ān nofūs-e ẓāleme ān Ṭalʿat-e Aḥadiyye rā āvīkhtand va shahīd namūdand. Ḥāl ham az hamān qabīl baʿḍī be vasāves-e khannāsiyye va khodʿe-hā-ye sheyṭāniyye peydā shode-and. Qātalahumu Allāhu wa aʿādhanā Allāhu wa iyyākum min sharri hāʾulāʾ.

All the learned of Iran, except a few, despite all their asceticism, piety, sermons, and austerities, issued a ruling for the execution of the Lord of the world—may the souls of all who dwell in the kingdoms of revelation and creation be sacrificed for Him. The square in Ādharbāyjān bears witness, and beyond it everyone endowed with sight and hearing, and beyond them all, God, exalted be His glory. In short, on the ruling of those unjust souls, they suspended that Countenance of divine unity and put Him to death. Now, too, some of the same kind have appeared with insidious whisperings and satanic deceptions. May God strike them down, and may God protect us and you from their evil.

25

لوحی هم مخصوص اماء آن ارض و آن دیار نازل قوله جلّ کبریائه و عزّ بیانه

Lowḥī ham makhṣūṣ-e emāʾ-e ān arḍ va ān diyār nāzel. Qawluhu jalla kibriyāʾuhu wa ʿazza bayānuhu:

A Tablet has also been revealed specifically for the handmaidens of that land and region. His words—exalted be His majesty and glorious His utterance:

26

بنام خداوند دانا و توانا

Be nām-e Khodāvand-e dānā va tavānā.

In the name of God, the All-Knowing, the All-Powerful.

27

یا امآء اللّه فی ارض البآء و الهآء و ضواحیها در امواج بحر فضل حقّ تفکّر نمائید در سجن ساکن و شما را لوجه اللّه بافق اعلی دعوت مینماید و بصراط مستقیم دلالت میفرماید از عالم غیب بشهود آمده تا کل را بفیوضات فیّاض حقیقی فائز فرماید بحبل متین الهی تمسّک نمائید و بافق ظهورش توجّه کنید امروز هر نفسی بعرفان حضرت دوست فائز شد او بکلّ خیر فائز است از بساط عالم بگذرید و بکمال نشاط و انبساط در بساط حقّ درآئید هر نفسی الیوم بافق اعلی ناظر و بذکر مالک اسماء ذاکر او از اهل بساط لدی اللّه محسوب آنچه مشاهده میشود عنقریب معدوم جهد نمائید تا بعملی فائز شوید که عرف بقا از او استشمام شود شکر کنید مقصود عالم را که شما را مؤیّد فرمود بر عرفان امریکه عالم از او محجوب انّه هو الفضّال الکریم الحمد له اذ هو ربّ العالمین و مقصود العارفین انتهی

Yā imāʾa Allāhi fī arḍi al-Bāʾi wa-al-Hāʾi wa ḍawāḥīhā, dar amvāj-e baḥr-e faḍl-e Ḥaqq tafakkor namāyīd. Dar sejn sāken va shomā rā li-wajhi Allāh be Ofoq-e Aʿlā daʿvat mīnamāyad va be ṣerāṭ-e mostaqīm delālat mīfarmāyad. Az ʿālam-e gheyb be shohūd āmade tā koll rā be foyūḍāt-e Fayyāḍ-e Ḥaqīqī fāʾez farmāyad. Be ḥabl-e matīn-e elāhī tamassok namāyīd va be ofoq-e ẓohūrash tavajjoh konīd. Emrūz har nafsī be ʿerfān-e Ḥaḍrat-e Dūst fāʾez shod ū be koll-e kheyr fāʾez ast. Az besāṭ-e ʿālam bogdharīd va be kamāl-e nashāṭ va enbesāṭ dar besāṭ-e Ḥaqq darāʾīd. Har nafsī al-yawm be Ofoq-e Aʿlā nāẓer va be dhekr-e Mālek-e Asmāʾ dhāker ū az ahl-e besāṭ ladā Allāh maḥsūb. Ānche moshāhede mīshavad ʿan-qarīb maʿdūm. Jahd namāyīd tā be ʿamalī fāʾez shavīd ke ʿarf-e baqā az ū esteshmām shavad. Shokr konīd Maqṣūd-e ʿĀlam rā ke shomā rā moʾayyad farmūd bar ʿerfān-e amrī ke ʿālam az ū maḥjūb. Innahu huwa al-Faḍḍālu al-Karīm. Al-ḥamdu lahu idh huwa Rabbu al-ʿālamīn wa Maqṣūdu al-ʿārifīn. Entahā.

O handmaidens of God in the land of Bāʾ and Hāʾ and its surroundings, reflect upon the waves of the ocean of God’s grace. He dwells in prison and, for the sake of God, calls you to the Most Exalted Horizon and guides you to the straight path. He has come from the unseen world into the visible so that He may enable all to partake of the outpourings of the true Bestower. Hold fast to the strong cord of God and turn toward the horizon of His Revelation. Whoever today attains recognition of the Beloved has attained all good. Pass beyond the court of the world and, with the utmost joy and gladness, enter the court of God. Whoever today looks toward the Most Exalted Horizon and remembers the Lord of Names is accounted by God among those admitted to His court. Whatever is seen will soon pass away. Strive to perform a deed from which the fragrance of eternity may be perceived. Give thanks to the Desire of the world, who has enabled you to recognize a Cause from which the world is veiled. He is indeed the Most Bountiful, the Generous. Praise be to Him, for He is the Lord of the worlds and the Desire of those who know Him. End.

28

للّه الحمد انوار آفتاب فضل الهی شامل حال امائش شد جمیع عالم مشتاق استماع کلمهٴ یا عبدی و حال امآء اللّه بکلمهٴ مبارکهٴ یا امتی فائزند این فضل عظیمست و بزرگ طوبی از برای نفسیکه عارف شد و شناخت و ویل للغافلین

Li-llāhi al-ḥamd, anvār-e āftāb-e faḍl-e elāhī shāmel-e ḥāl-e emāʾash shod. Jamīʿ-e ʿālam moshtāq-e estemāʿ-e kaleme-ye yā ʿabdī va ḥāl emāʾ Allāh be kaleme-ye mobārake-ye yā amatī fāʾezand. Īn faḍl ʿaẓīm ast va bozorg. Ṭūbā az barā-ye nafsī ke ʿāref shod va shenākht, wa waylun li-l-ghāfilīn.

Praise be to God, the rays of the sun of divine grace have embraced His handmaidens. The whole world longs to hear the words “O My servant,” and now the handmaidens of God have been favored with the blessed words “O My handmaiden.” This is a mighty and great bounty. Blessed is the soul who has understood and recognized it, and woe to the heedless.

29

اینکه ذکر جناب استاد احمد (ک‌ف) علیه بهآء اللّه را نمودند در ساحت امنع اقدس مالک الرّقاب عرض شد هذا ما نزّل فی الجواب قوله جلّ جلاله و عمّ نواله

Īnke dhekr-e Janāb-e Ostād Aḥmad (K-F), ʿalayhi Bahāʾu Allāh, rā namūdand dar sāḥat-e amnaʿ-e aqdas-e Mālek-e Reqāb ʿarḍ shod. Hādhā mā nuzzila fī al-jawāb. Qawluhu jalla jalāluhu wa ʿamma nawāluhu:

The mention that was made of Ustād Aḥmad (K-F), upon him be the glory of God, was submitted at the most inviolate, most holy court of the Lord of all. This is what was revealed in reply. His words—exalted be His glory and all-embracing His bounty:

30

هو السّمیع البصیر

Huwa al-Samīʿu al-Baṣīr.

He is the All-Hearing, the All-Seeing.

31

یا احمد یذکرک مقصود العالم و یبشّرک بعنایة اللّه المهیمن القیّوم طوبی لوجه توجّه الیه و لقلب اقبل الی شطره و لبصر رأی الأفق الأعلی و للسان نطق امام الوجوه انّه لا اله الّا هو الفرد الواحد العزیز الودود انّا جدّدنا العالم من نفحات الوحی و اظهرنا ربیع المعانی و القوم اکثرهم لا یفقهون قد ماج بحر البیان و الرّحمن استوی علی عرش البرهان و النّاس هم لا یعرفون قد نبذوا الههم و اخذوا اهوائهم الا انّهم لا یعلمون طوبی لمن کسّر اصنام الظّنون و آمن باللّه ربّ ما کان و ما یکون یا احمد قد حضر کتاب من الأمین و کان فیه ذکرک و الّذین آمنوا هناک ذکرناکم من هذا المقام المحمود ان اعرف هذا المقام الأعلی لعمر اللّه لا یعادل بذکری ما یشهد و یری یشهد بذلک من عنده الرّحیق المختوم

Yā Aḥmad, yadhkuruka Maqṣūdu al-ʿālam wa yubashshiruka bi-ʿināyati Allāhi al-Muhaymini al-Qayyūm. Ṭūbā li-wajhin tawajjaha ilayhi wa li-qalbin aqbala ilā shaṭrihi wa li-baṣarin raʾā al-ufuqa al-aʿlā wa li-lisānin naṭaqa amāma al-wujūhi innahu lā ilāha illā huwa al-Fardu al-Wāḥidu al-ʿAzīzu al-Wadūd. Innā jaddadnā al-ʿālama min nafaḥāti al-waḥyi wa aẓharnā rabīʿa al-maʿānī wa-al-qawmu aktharuhum lā yafqahūn. Qad māja baḥru al-bayāni wa-al-Raḥmānu istawā ʿalā ʿarshi al-burhāni wa-al-nāsu hum lā yaʿrifūn. Qad nabadhū ilāhahum wa akhadhū ahwāʾahum a-lā innahum lā yaʿlamūn. Ṭūbā li-man kassara aṣnāma al-ẓunūni wa āmana bi-Allāhi Rabbi mā kāna wa mā yakūn. Yā Aḥmad, qad ḥaḍara kitābun mina al-Amīn wa kāna fīhi dhikruka wa-alladhīna āmanū hunāk. Dhakarnākum min hādhā al-maqāmi al-maḥmūd. An iʿraf hādhā al-maqāma al-aʿlā. La-ʿamru Allāh, lā yuʿādilu bi-dhikrī mā yushhadu wa yurā. Yashhadu bi-dhālika man ʿindahu al-raḥīqu al-makhtūm.

O Aḥmad, the Desire of the world remembers you and gives you the glad tidings of the loving-kindness of God, the All-Protecting, the Self-Subsisting. Blessed is the face that has turned toward Him, the heart that has inclined in His direction, the eye that has beheld the Most Exalted Horizon, and the tongue that has proclaimed before all faces, “There is no god but Him, the Unique, the One, the Almighty, the All-Loving.” We have indeed renewed the world through the breaths of revelation and brought forth the springtime of meanings, yet most of the people do not understand. The ocean of utterance has surged, and the All-Merciful has ascended the throne of proof, yet the people do not recognize Him. They have cast aside their God and taken hold of their own desires. Surely, they do not know. Blessed is the one who has shattered the idols of idle suppositions and believed in God, the Lord of all that has been and all that will be. O Aḥmad, a letter has arrived from Amīn, in which you and those who have believed in that land were mentioned. We have remembered you from this praiseworthy station. Recognize this most exalted station. By the life of God, nothing witnessed or seen can equal My remembrance. To this bears witness the One with whom is the sealed wine.

32

یا سیّد قبل هاشم ان استمع ندآء اللّه انّه ارتفع مرّة فی الطّآء و اخری فی الزّورآء و تارةً فی ارض السّرّ و فی هذا المقام الّذی سمّی بالأسمآء الحسنی من لدی اللّه مولی الوری یشهد بذلک من شهد انّه لا اله الّا هو العزیز المحبوب ان افرح بذکری ثمّ انطق بثنآء ربّک فی العشیّ و البکور

Yā Sayyid qabla Hāshim, an istamiʿ nidāʾa Allāh. Innahu irtafaʿa marratan fī al-Ṭāʾi wa ukhrā fī al-Zawrāʾi wa tāratan fī Arḍi al-Sirri wa fī hādhā al-maqāmi alladhī summiya bi-al-asmāʾi al-ḥusnā min ladā Allāhi Mawlā al-warā. Yashhadu bi-dhālika man shahida annahu lā ilāha illā huwa al-ʿAzīzu al-Maḥbūb. An ifraḥ bi-dhikrī thumma inṭiq bi-thanāʾi Rabbika fī al-ʿashiyyi wa-al-bukūr.

O Siyyid, whose name is followed by Hāshim, listen to the call of God. It rose once in Ṭāʾ, another time in Zawrāʾ, and again in the Land of Mystery and in this station, which has been designated by the most beautiful names by God, the Lord of humanity. To this bears witness the One who has testified that there is no god but Him, the Almighty, the Beloved. Rejoice in My remembrance, then speak the praise of your Lord at evening and at dawn.

33

و نذکر من سمّی بسیّد قبل محمّد لیفرح و یکون من الشّاکرین انّا ذکرنا الّذین اقبلوا الی الأفق الأعلی و نذکرهم رحمة من عندنا لتبقی به اذکارهم بدوام اسمآء اللّه الحسنی و صفاته العلیا لا اله الّا هو المقتدر العلیم الخبیر انّ اللّه جعل ذکره کنزاً لأحبّائه الّذین اقبلوا الیه بوجوه بیضآء و عملوا بما امروا به فی کتابه المبین یا اولیآء الرّحمن انّا نوصیکم بحفظ کنوزکم کذلک یعظکم من عنده علم کلّشیء و یطوف حوله الملأ الأعلی فی مقامه الکریم و نذکر اولیائی هناک الّذین ما نقضوا المیثاق اذ ارتفع النّعاق الا انّهم من الرّاسخین طوبی لعبد ما زلّته شبهات الفجّار و ما منعته اشارات المغلّین الّذین یغلی فی صدورهم قدر البغضآء و یری من وجوههم غبرة الجحیم البهآء المشرق من افق سمآء عنایتی علیکم یا حزب اللّه هناک و علی الّذین یطوفون العرش فی مقامی الرّفیع انتهی

Wa nadhkuru man summiya bi-Sayyid qabla Muḥammad li-yafraḥa wa yakūna mina al-shākirīn. Innā dhakarnā alladhīna aqbalū ilā al-ufuqi al-aʿlā wa nadhkuruhum raḥmatan min ʿindinā li-tabqā bihi adhkāruhum bi-dawāmi asmāʾi Allāhi al-ḥusnā wa ṣifātihi al-ʿulyā. Lā ilāha illā huwa al-Muqtadiru al-ʿAlīmu al-Khabīr. Inna Allāha jaʿala dhikrahu kanzan li-aḥibbāʾihi alladhīna aqbalū ilayhi bi-wujūhin bayḍāʾa wa ʿamilū bi-mā umirū bihi fī kitābihi al-mubīn. Yā awliyāʾa al-Raḥmān, innā nūṣīkum bi-ḥifẓi kunūzikum. Kadhālika yaʿiẓukum man ʿindahu ʿilmu kulli shayʾin wa yaṭūfu ḥawlahu al-malaʾu al-aʿlā fī maqāmihi al-karīm. Wa nadhkuru awliyāʾī hunāka alladhīna mā naqaḍū al-mīthāqa idh irtafaʿa al-nuʿāq. A-lā innahum mina al-rāsikhīn. Ṭūbā li-ʿabdin mā zallat-hu shubuhātu al-fujjāri wa mā manaʿat-hu ishārātu al-mughillīna alladhīna yaghlī fī ṣudūrihim qidru al-baghḍāʾi wa yurā min wujūhihim ghubratu al-jaḥīm. Al-Bahāʾu al-mushriqu min ufuqi samāʾi ʿināyatī ʿalaykum yā ḥizba Allāhi hunāka wa ʿalā alladhīna yaṭūfūna al-ʿarsha fī maqāmī al-rafīʿ. Intahā.

And We remember the one named Siyyid followed by Muḥammad, that he may rejoice and be among the thankful. We have remembered those who have turned toward the Most Exalted Horizon, and We remember them as a mercy from Us, so that through it their remembrance may endure as long as God’s most beautiful names and most exalted attributes endure. There is no god but Him, the All-Powerful, the All-Knowing, the All-Informed. God has made His remembrance a treasure for His loved ones who have turned toward Him with radiant faces and acted according to what they were commanded in His perspicuous Book. O loved ones of the All-Merciful, We exhort you to safeguard your treasures. Thus admonishes you the One who possesses the knowledge of all things and around whom the Concourse on high circles in His noble station. And We remember My loved ones in that land who did not break the Covenant when the clamor arose. Surely, they are among the steadfast. Blessed is the servant whom the doubts raised by the wicked have not caused to slip, nor the insinuations of the spiteful deterred—those in whose breasts the cauldron of hatred boils and upon whose faces the dust of hell can be seen. The glory shining from the horizon of the heaven of My loving-kindness rest upon you, O people of God in that land, and upon those who circle the throne in My exalted station. End.

34

و هذا ما نزّل لجناب استاد باقر علیه بهآء اللّه قوله جلّ جلاله و عزّ کبریائه و عظم شأنه

Wa hādhā mā nuzzila li-Janāb-e Ostād Bāqer, ʿalayhi Bahāʾu Allāh. Qawluhu jalla jalāluhu wa ʿazza kibriyāʾuhu wa ʿaẓuma shaʾnuhu:

And this is what was revealed for Ustād Bāqir, upon him be the glory of God. His words—exalted be His glory, glorious His majesty, and great His station:

35

بسمی المشفق الکریم

Bi-smī al-Mushfiqi al-Karīm.

In My name, the Compassionate, the Generous.

36

سبحان الّذی سخّر الملک و الملکوت امراً من عنده و هو القویّ الغالب القدیر یفعل ما یشآء و یحکم ما یرید و هو الفرد الواحد العلیم الحکیم یا باقر انّا ذکرناک من قبل و فی هذا الحین لعمری لو تعرف مقام ذکری لیأخذک الفرح علی شأن لا تحزنک شئونات البشر و لا سطوة الغافلین کن مستقیماً علی امر ربّک و ناطقاً بثنائه الجمیل هذا ما ینفعک و اولیائی فی الآخرة و الأولی یشهد بذلک من استوی علی عرشه العظیم کن قائماً علی خدمة امری و مقبلاً بقلبک الی افقی انّه یؤیّد من اقبل الیه بقلب منیر قد شهد لک قلمی الأعلی ان اعرف و کن من الشّاکرین ایّاک ان تحجبک شئونات الفجّار الّذین ینطقون بأهوائهم و یمنعون النّاس عن صراطی المستقیم البهآء علیک و علی من سمع النّدآء و اجاب ربّ الکرسیّ الرّفیع انتهی

Subḥāna alladhī sakhkhara al-mulka wa-al-malakūta amran min ʿindihi wa huwa al-Qawiyyu al-Ghālibu al-Qadīr. Yafʿalu mā yashāʾu wa yaḥkumu mā yurīdu wa huwa al-Fardu al-Wāḥidu al-ʿAlīmu al-Ḥakīm. Yā Bāqir, innā dhakarnāka min qablu wa fī hādhā al-ḥīn. La-ʿamrī, law taʿrifu maqāma dhikrī la-yaʾkhudhuka al-faraḥu ʿalā shaʾnin lā tuḥzinuka shuʾūnātu al-bashari wa lā saṭwatu al-ghāfilīn. Kun mustaqīman ʿalā amri Rabbika wa nāṭiqan bi-thanāʾihi al-jamīl. Hādhā mā yanfaʿuka wa awliyāʾī fī al-ākhirati wa-al-ūlā. Yashhadu bi-dhālika man istawā ʿalā ʿarshihi al-ʿaẓīm. Kun qāʾiman ʿalā khidmati amrī wa muqbilan bi-qalbika ilā ufuqī. Innahu yuʾayyidu man aqbala ilayhi bi-qalbin munīr. Qad shahida laka qalamī al-aʿlā. An iʿraf wa kun mina al-shākirīn. Iyyāka an taḥjubaka shuʾūnātu al-fujjāri alladhīna yanṭiqūna bi-ahwāʾihim wa yamnaʿūna al-nāsa ʿan ṣirāṭī al-mustaqīm. Al-Bahāʾu ʿalayka wa ʿalā man samiʿa al-nidāʾa wa ajāba Rabba al-kursiyyi al-rafīʿ. Intahā.

Glory be to Him who has subjected the earthly and heavenly kingdoms to a command from Himself. He is the Strong, the All-Subduing, the All-Powerful. He does whatever He wills and ordains whatever He desires, and He is the Unique, the One, the All-Knowing, the All-Wise. O Bāqir, We have remembered you before and at this time. By My life, if you knew the station of My remembrance, such joy would seize you that neither human affairs nor the onslaught of the heedless could grieve you. Be steadfast in the Cause of your Lord and speak His glorious praise. This is what will benefit you and My loved ones in the world to come and in this world. To this bears witness the One who has ascended His mighty throne. Arise to serve My Cause and turn your heart toward My horizon. He indeed assists whoever turns toward Him with a luminous heart. My Most Exalted Pen has borne witness in your favor. Recognize this and be among the thankful. Beware lest the doings of the wicked veil you—those who speak according to their own desires and keep people from My straight path. Glory rest upon you and upon whoever has heard the call and answered the Lord of the lofty throne. End.

37

و هذا ما نزّل لجناب ابوالقاسم علیه بهآء اللّه قوله جلّ جلاله و عزّ شأنه

Wa-hādhā mā nuzzila li-janāb Abī al-Qāsim ʿalayhi bahāʾ Allāh, qawluhu jalla jalāluhu wa-ʿazza shaʾnuhu.

And this is what was revealed for Abū al-Qāsim, upon him be the glory of God. His words—glorious is His majesty and exalted His station:

38

بسمی النّاطق الأمین

Bi-smī al-Nāṭiq al-Amīn.

In My name, the Speaker, the Trustworthy.

39

یا اباالقاسم یذکرک المظلوم فی مقام یطوفه الملأ الأعلی و یوصیک بتقوی اللّه انّ ربّک لهو النّاصح العلیم انّه یذکر من اقبل الیه و یرید من اراده انّه خلق الوفآء و جعله من اسمائه الحسنی فی کتابه المبین طوبی لمن تمسّک به انّه من فوارس مضمار البیان لدی الرّحمن یشهد بذلک کلّ عارف بصیر ان افرح بذکری ایّاک ثمّ اشکر ربّک الّذی خلقک و ایّدک و هداک الی افقه المنیر انّا نذکر اولیائی هناک و نبشّرهم برحمتی الّتی سبقت من فی السّموات و الأرضین قد ذکرک الأمین ذکرناک ان اشکر من انقذک و نجّاک و انزل لک ما یجد منه المقرّبون عرف رحمة ربّک الغفور الرّحیم انتهی

Yā Abā al-Qāsim, yadhkuruka al-Maẓlūm fī maqām yaṭūfuhu al-malaʾ al-aʿlā wa-yūṣīka bi-taqwā Allāh. Inna rabbaka la-huwa al-Nāṣiḥ al-ʿAlīm. Innahu yadhkuru man aqbala ilayhi wa-yurīdu man arādahu. Innahu khalaqa al-wafāʾ wa-jaʿalahu min asmāʾihi al-ḥusnā fī kitābihi al-mubīn. Ṭūbā li-man tamassaka bihi, innahu min fawāris miḍmār al-bayān ladā al-Raḥmān. Yashhadu bi-dhālika kullu ʿārif baṣīr. An ifraḥ bi-dhikrī iyyāka thumma ushkur rabbaka alladhī khalaqaka wa-ayyadaka wa-hadāka ilā ufuqihi al-munīr. Innā nadhkuru awliyāʾī hunāka wa-nubashshiruhum bi-raḥmatī allatī sabaqat man fī al-samāwāt wa-al-araḍīn. Qad dhakaraka al-Amīn, dhakarnāka. An ishkur man anqadhaka wa-najjāka wa-anzala laka mā yajidu minhu al-muqarrabūn ʿarfa raḥmati rabbika al-Ghafūr al-Raḥīm. Intahā.

O Abū al-Qāsim, the Wronged One remembers you in a station around which the heavenly Concourse circles, and counsels you to be mindful of God. Your Lord is indeed the Counselor, the All-Knowing. He remembers whoever turns toward Him and desires whoever desires Him. He created faithfulness and made it one of His most beautiful names in His clear Book. Blessed is whoever holds fast to it; in the presence of the All-Merciful, he is among the horsemen in the arena of utterance. Every discerning knower bears witness to this. Rejoice in My remembrance of you, then thank your Lord, who created you, strengthened you, and guided you to His luminous horizon. We remember My loved ones there and give them the glad tidings of My mercy, which has preceded all who are in the heavens and the earths. The Trustworthy One has mentioned you, and We have remembered you. Give thanks to Him who rescued and saved you and revealed for you that from which those brought near perceive the fragrance of the mercy of your Lord, the Ever-Forgiving, the Merciful. End.

40

و هذا ما نزّل لجناب ملّا حسن علیه بهآء اللّه قوله عظمت آیاته و جلّ سلطانه

Wa-hādhā mā nuzzila li-janāb Mullā Ḥasan ʿalayhi bahāʾ Allāh, qawluhu ʿaẓumat āyātuhu wa-jalla sulṭānuhu.

And this is what was revealed for Mullā Ḥasan, upon him be the glory of God. His words—great are His signs and glorious His sovereignty:

41

هو الصّراط المستقیم

Huwa al-ṣirāṭ al-mustaqīm.

He is the straight path.

42

کتاب انزله المظلوم و فیه یذکر من اقبل الی اللّه مولی العالم و اجاب اذ ارتفع ندائه من هذا المقام الّذی جعله من اعلی المقام قد خلقت الأبصار لمشاهدة افقی و الآذان لاصغآء ندائی و اللّسان لذکری الّذی به اشرقت الآفاق یا حسن ان استمع ندآء مکلّم الطّور فی هذا الظّهور ثمّ اشکر ربّک بما ایّدک علی عرفان هذا الأمر الّذی به زلّت الأقدام انّا سمّینا هذا الیوم فی کتب القبل بیوم اللّه ولکنّ القوم اکثرهم فی غفلة و حجاب قد منعتهم السّبحات عن النّظر الی الأفق الأعلی و الشّبهات عن الّذی اتی من سمآء القوّة برایات الآیات کن ناطقاً بذکر ربّک و عاملاً بما امرت به فی الزّبر و الألواح طوبی لذی ظمأ قصد الفرات و لذی وجه توجّه الی اللّه مالک الأدیان قل ضعوا الظّنون و الأوهام مسرعین الی ملکوت الایقان بالرّوح و الرّیحان کذلک هطلت من سمآء عنایتی امطار رحمتی نعیماً لمن فاز و ویل لکلّ غافل مرتاب البهآء من لدنّا علی الّذین ما حجّبتهم حجبات العلمآء و ما خوّفتهم سطوة الّذین اعرضوا عن المبدء و المآب

Kitāb anzalahu al-Maẓlūm wa-fīhi yadhkuru man aqbala ilā Allāh mawlā al-ʿālam wa-ajāba idh irtafaʿa nidāʾuhu min hādhā al-maqām alladhī jaʿalahu min aʿlā al-maqām. Qad khuliqat al-abṣār li-mushāhadati ufuqī wa-al-ādhān li-iṣghāʾi nidāʾī wa-al-lisān li-dhikrī alladhī bihi ashraqat al-āfāq. Yā Ḥasan, an istamiʿ nidāʾa Mukallim al-Ṭūr fī hādhā al-ẓuhūr thumma ushkur rabbaka bi-mā ayyadaka ʿalā ʿirfān hādhā al-amr alladhī bihi zallat al-aqdām. Innā sammaynā hādhā al-yawm fī kutub al-qabl bi-yawm Allāh wa-lākinna al-qawm aktharuhum fī ghafla wa-ḥijāb. Qad manaʿathumu al-subuḥāt ʿan al-naẓar ilā al-ufuq al-aʿlā wa-al-shubuhāt ʿan alladhī atā min samāʾ al-quwwa bi-rāyāt al-āyāt. Kun nāṭiqan bi-dhikr rabbika wa-ʿāmilan bi-mā umirta bihi fī al-zubur wa-al-alwāḥ. Ṭūbā li-dhī ẓamaʾ qaṣada al-Furāt wa-li-dhī wajh tawajjaha ilā Allāh Mālik al-Adyān. Qul ḍaʿū al-ẓunūn wa-al-awhām musriʿīn ilā malakūt al-īqān bi-al-rūḥ wa-al-rayḥān. Kadhālika haṭalat min samāʾ ʿināyatī amṭār raḥmatī. Naʿīman li-man fāz wa-wayl li-kulli ghāfil murtāb. Al-bahāʾ min ladunnā ʿalā alladhīna mā ḥajjabathum ḥujubāt al-ʿulamāʾ wa-mā khawwafathum saṭwat alladhīna aʿraḍū ʿan al-Mabdaʾ wa-al-Maʾāb.

A Book revealed by the Wronged One, in which He remembers whoever has turned toward God, the Lord of the world, and answered when His call arose from this station, which He has made one of the loftiest stations. Eyes were created to behold My horizon, ears to hear My call, and the tongue to remember Me, through which the horizons have been illumined. O Ḥasan, listen to the call of Him who spoke on Sinai in this Revelation, then thank your Lord for enabling you to recognize this Cause, through which feet have slipped. We named this day the Day of God in the Books of the past, yet most people remain heedless and veiled. The veils of glory have prevented them from looking toward the Most Exalted Horizon, and doubts have kept them from Him who has come from the heaven of power with the banners of the verses. Speak in remembrance of your Lord and act according to what you have been commanded in the Scriptures and Tablets. Blessed is the thirsty one who has sought the Euphrates, and the one who has turned his face toward God, the Sovereign of all religions. Say: Set aside conjectures and vain imaginings, hastening toward the kingdom of certitude with joy and gladness. Thus have the rains of My mercy poured from the heaven of My loving care. Bliss to whoever has attained, and woe to every heedless doubter. Glory from Our presence rest upon those whom the veils of the learned have not veiled and whom the might of those who have turned away from the Origin and the Return has not frightened.

43

و هذا ما نزّل لجناب غلام رضا من لدی اللّه مولی الأسمآء قوله جلّ جلاله و عزّ بیانه

Wa-hādhā mā nuzzila li-janāb Ghulām Riḍā min ladā Allāh Mawlā al-Asmāʾ, qawluhu jalla jalāluhu wa-ʿazza bayānuhu.

And this is what was revealed for Ghulām Riḍā from God, the Lord of Names. His words—glorious is His majesty and exalted His utterance:

44

بسمی المهیمن علی الأسمآء

Bi-smī al-Muhaymin ʿalā al-asmāʾ.

In My name, the Guardian over all names.

45

یا غلام رضا عالم را دخان ریب و غبار اوهام از مالک انام منع نموده حجبات نفس و هوی بشأنی قوم را اخذ کرده که خیر و شر و معروف و منکر را از هم تمیز نمیدهند اهل شرکند و خود را اهل توحید میدانند و عبدهٴ اصنامند و خود را اهل مقام میشمرند غفلت بمقامی رسیده که نعمت ابدی را بآلاء فانیه تبدیل نموده‌اند آنچه حقّ جلّ جلاله از برای کل خواسته از آن گذشته‌اند و بمشتهیات نفس و هوی مشغولند افّ لهم و بما اکتسبت ایدیهم حمد کن مقصود عالمیانرا که ترا مؤیّد فرمود بر اقبال قدر این عنایت بزرگ را بدان و لآلی محبّت الهی را از ابصار خائنه و نفوس سارقه باسمش محفوظ دار اینست نصیحت قلم اعلی در این لیلهٴ ظلما اسمع و کن من الشّاکرین و الحمد لله ربّ العالمین

Yā Gholām Reḍā, ʿālam rā dokhān-e rayb va ghobār-e awhām az Mālek-e anām manʿ namūde. Ḥojobāt-e nafs va havā be-shaʾnī qawm rā akhdh karde ke khayr va sharr va maʿrūf va monkar rā az ham tamīz nemīdahand. Ahl-e sherkand va khod rā ahl-e tawḥīd mīdānand va ʿabade-ye aṣnāmand va khod rā ahl-e maqām mīshomorand. Ghaflat be-maqāmī resīde ke neʿmat-e abadī rā be-ālā-ye fāniye tabdīl namūde-and. Ānche Ḥaqq jalla jalāluhu az barā-ye koll khāste az ān godhashte-and va be-moshtahayāt-e nafs va havā mashghūland. Uffin lahum wa-bi-mā iktasabat aydīhim. Ḥamd kon Maqṣūd-e ʿālamiyān rā ke to rā moʾayyad farmūd bar eqbāl. Qadr-e īn ʿenāyat-e bozorg rā bedān va laʾālī-ye maḥabbat-e elāhī rā az abṣār-e khāʾene va nofūs-e sāreqe be-esmash maḥfūẓ dār. Īnast naṣīḥat-e Qalam-e Aʿlā dar īn layle-ye ẓalmā. Ismaʿ wa-kun min al-shākirīn wa-al-ḥamdu li-llāh Rabb al-ʿālamīn.

O Ghulām Riḍā, the smoke of doubt and the dust of vain imaginings have kept the world from the Sovereign of humankind. The veils of self and desire have so seized the people that they cannot distinguish good from evil or right from wrong. They associate partners with God yet consider themselves believers in His unity; they worship idols yet count themselves among those of spiritual rank. Heedlessness has reached such a degree that they have exchanged the everlasting blessing for fleeting favors. They have forsaken whatever God—glorious is His majesty—has desired for all, and are occupied with the cravings of self and desire. Shame on them and on what their hands have earned! Praise the Desire of all peoples, who has enabled you to turn toward Him. Appreciate this great favor, and in His name guard the pearls of divine love from treacherous eyes and thieving souls. This is the counsel of the Most Exalted Pen in this dark night. Listen and be among the thankful. Praise be to God, the Lord of all worlds.

46

و هذا ما نزّل لجناب علی اکبر (س‌م‌س) من لدی اللّه مالک القدر قوله تبارک و تعالی

Wa-hādhā mā nuzzila li-janāb ʿAlī Akbar (s-m-s) min ladā Allāh Mālik al-Qadar, qawluhu tabāraka wa-taʿālā.

And this is what was revealed for ʿAlī Akbar (s-m-s) from God, the Sovereign of destiny. His words—blessed and exalted is He:

47

هو السّامع و هو المجیب

Huwa al-Sāmiʿ wa-huwa al-Mujīb.

He is the Hearer, and He is the Answerer.

48

یا حزب اللّه امروز بر کل ذکر حقّ جلّ جلاله و خدمت امر لازم در قرون و اعصار قوم منتظر این یوم مبارک بوده‌اند و چون باب عنایت رحمن بمفتاح بیان گشوده شد و طلعت موعود و مکلّم طور خود را لأجل نجات عالم و هدایت امم ظاهر فرمود کل محجوب بل منصعق بل میّت مشاهده شدند مگر معدودی قلیل که از احرف وجه در کتاب الهی مذکورند ای دوستان بقول اکتفا ننمائید امروز یوم عمل است قدر ایّام را بدانید و بآنچه سزاوار است مشغول گردید بگو الوان مختلفهٴ فانیهٴ این دو یوم شما را از نعماء باقیه و آلاء دائمهٴ الهی منع ننماید عنقریب کل مشاهده نمایند آنچه را که الیوم از او غافلند آنحین ندامت ثمری ندارد و تأسّف را اثری نه امروز روز خدمت است جهد نمائید شاید بآنچه لایق است فائز گردید انّ ربّکم الرّحمن هو المقتدر علی ما یشآء و فی قبضته زمام الأشیآء و هو المهیمن علی من فی الغیب و الشّهود

Yā Ḥezb Allāh, emrūz bar koll dhekr-e Ḥaqq jalla jalāluhu va khedmat-e amr lāzem. Dar qorūn va aʿṣār qawm montaẓer-e īn yawm-e mobārak būde-and va chūn bāb-e ʿenāyat-e Raḥmān be-meftāḥ-e bayān goshūde shod va Ṭalʿat-e Mawʿūd va Mokallem-e Ṭūr khod rā li-ajli najāt-e ʿālam va hedāyat-e omam ẓāher farmūd, koll maḥjūb bal monṣaʿeq bal mayyet moshāhade shodand magar maʿdūdī qalīl ke az aḥrof-e vajh dar ketāb-e elāhī madhkūrand. Ey dūstān, be-qawl ektefā nanamāyīd. Emrūz yawm-e ʿamal ast. Qadr-e ayyām rā bedānīd va be-ānche sazāvār ast mashghūl gardīd. Begū alvān-e mokhtalefe-ye fāniye-ye īn do yawm shomā rā az naʿmā-ye bāqiye va ālā-ye dāʾeme-ye elāhī manʿ nanamāyad. ʿAn-qarīb koll moshāhade namāyand ānche rā ke al-yawm az ū ghāfeland. Ānḥīn nadāmat thamarī nadārad va taʾassof rā atharī na. Emrūz rūz-e khedmat ast. Jahd namāyīd shāyad be-ānche lāyeq ast fāʾez gardīd. Inna rabbakum al-Raḥmān huwa al-muqtadir ʿalā mā yashāʾ wa-fī qabḍatihi zimām al-ashyāʾ wa-huwa al-muhaymin ʿalā man fī al-ghayb wa-al-shuhūd.

O people of God, today it is incumbent on everyone to remember God—glorious is His majesty—and to serve the Cause. Through centuries and ages the people awaited this blessed Day, yet when the door of the All-Merciful’s loving care was opened with the key of utterance, and the promised Beauty, who spoke on Sinai, revealed Himself to save the world and guide the nations, all were seen to be veiled—indeed, thunderstruck, indeed, dead—except for a small number who are mentioned among the letters of the Face in the divine Book. O friends, do not content yourselves with words. Today is the day for action. Appreciate these days and occupy yourselves with what is fitting. Say: Do not let the varied, fleeting colors of these two days keep you from the abiding blessings and enduring favors of God. Soon all will behold that of which they are heedless today. Then remorse will bear no fruit, and regret will have no effect. Today is the day of service. Strive, that you may attain what is worthy. Your Lord, the All-Merciful, has power over whatever He wills. In His grasp are the reins of all things, and He is the Guardian over all who are in the unseen and the visible realms.

49

و هذا ما نزّل لجناب میرزا مهدی ابن من صعد علیهما بهآء اللّه قوله جلّت عظمته و عزّ کبریائه

Wa-hādhā mā nuzzila li-janāb Mīrzā Mahdī ibn man ṣaʿida ʿalayhimā bahāʾ Allāh, qawluhu jallat ʿaẓamatuhu wa-ʿazza kibriyāʾuhu.

And this is what was revealed for Mīrzā Mahdī, son of the one who has ascended, upon them both be the glory of God. His words—glorious is His grandeur and exalted His majesty:

50

هو المشرق من افق الملکوت

Huwa al-mushriq min ufuq al-malakūt.

He is the One shining from the horizon of the Kingdom.

51

لوح انزله الرّحمن و منه تمرّ عرف البیان علی الامکان تعالی من انزله و تعالی من اظهره و تعالی من نطق و انطق کلّشیء علی انّه لا اله الّا هو الفرد الواحد العلیم الحکیم قد ارتفع النّدآء و نطق الکلیل و القوم اکثرهم من الرّاقدین قد منعتهم النّفس عن الفردوس الأعلی و الهوی عن مالک الوری الا انّهم من الأخسرین فی کتاب اللّه ربّ العالمین قد اتی من کان مذکوراً بألسن الأصفیآء و مسطوراً فی کتب اللّه ربّ العرش العظیم من النّاس من سمع و انکر و منهم من سمع و سرع الی ان فاز بکوثر البیان و شرب منه باسمه الغفور الکریم یا اهل البهآء ان استمعوا النّدآء من شطر البقعة النّورآء و الأرض البیضآء انّه یدعوکم بالحقّ و یبشّرکم بعنایة اللّه مالک یوم الدّین ایّاکم ان یمنعکم حبّ الدّنیا عن مولی الوری او تحزنکم اشارات الغافلین کونوا ثابتین علی الأمر علی شأن لا تزلّکم شبهات اهل البیان الّذین اعرضوا عن الحقّ اذ اتیهم بسلطان مبین لعمر اللّه انّهم ما فازوا بالبیان و ما شربوا رحیق العرفان من ایادی عنایة الرّحمن و انکروا الّذی خلقوا لخدمة امره المبرم المتین یا معشر البیان تاللّه لا تنفعکم الیوم کتب العالم و لا ملکوت الأسمآء الّا بهذا الکتاب الّذی ینطق فی اللّیالی و الأیّام و یبشّر الکلّ بما عند اللّه العلیّ العظیم کذلک نطق قلمی الأعلی و القوم اکثرهم من الغافلین البهآء من لدنّا علی الّذین نبذوا ما عند النّاس رجآء ما عند اللّه الا انّهم من الرّاسخین الحمد للّه ربّ العالمین

Lawḥ anzalahu al-Raḥmān wa-minhu tamurru ʿarf al-bayān ʿalā al-imkān. Taʿālā man anzalahu wa-taʿālā man aẓharahu wa-taʿālā man naṭaqa wa-anṭaqa kulla shayʾ ʿalā annahu lā ilāha illā huwa al-Fard al-Wāḥid al-ʿAlīm al-Ḥakīm. Qad irtafaʿa al-nidāʾ wa-naṭaqa al-kalīl wa-al-qawm aktharuhum min al-rāqidīn. Qad manaʿathumu al-nafs ʿan al-Firdaws al-aʿlā wa-al-hawā ʿan Mālik al-warā. Alā innahum min al-akhsarīn fī kitāb Allāh Rabb al-ʿālamīn. Qad atā man kāna madhkūran bi-alsun al-aṣfiyāʾ wa-masṭūran fī kutub Allāh Rabb al-ʿarsh al-ʿaẓīm. Min al-nās man samiʿa wa-ankara wa-minhum man samiʿa wa-saraʿa ilā an fāza bi-kawthar al-bayān wa-shariba minhu bi-smihi al-Ghafūr al-Karīm. Yā ahl al-Bahāʾ, an istamiʿū al-nidāʾ min shaṭr al-buqʿa al-nawrāʾ wa-al-arḍ al-bayḍāʾ. Innahu yadʿūkum bi-al-ḥaqq wa-yubashshirukum bi-ʿināyat Allāh Mālik yawm al-dīn. Iyyākum an yamnaʿakum ḥubb al-dunyā ʿan Mawlā al-warā aw tuḥzinakum ishārāt al-ghāfilīn. Kūnū thābitīn ʿalā al-amr ʿalā shaʾn lā tuzillakum shubuhāt ahl al-Bayān alladhīna aʿraḍū ʿan al-Ḥaqq idh atāhum bi-sulṭān mubīn. La-ʿamr Allāh innahum mā fāzū bi-al-Bayān wa-mā sharibū raḥīq al-ʿirfān min ayādī ʿināyat al-Raḥmān wa-ankarū alladhī khuliqū li-khidmati amrihi al-mubram al-matīn. Yā maʿshar al-Bayān, ta-Allāh lā tanfaʿukumu al-yawm kutub al-ʿālam wa-lā malakūt al-asmāʾ illā bi-hādhā al-kitāb alladhī yanṭiqu fī al-layālī wa-al-ayyām wa-yubashshiru al-kull bi-mā ʿinda Allāh al-ʿAliyy al-ʿAẓīm. Kadhālika naṭaqa qalamī al-aʿlā wa-al-qawm aktharuhum min al-ghāfilīn. Al-bahāʾ min ladunnā ʿalā alladhīna nabadhū mā ʿinda al-nās rajāʾa mā ʿinda Allāh. Alā innahum min al-rāsikhīn. Al-ḥamdu li-llāh Rabb al-ʿālamīn.

A Tablet revealed by the All-Merciful, from which the fragrance of utterance passes over the world of being. Exalted is He who revealed it, exalted is He who made it manifest, and exalted is He who has spoken and caused all things to proclaim that there is no god but Him, the Unique, the One, the All-Knowing, the All-Wise. The call has risen and the faltering tongue has spoken, yet most people are asleep. Self has kept them from the most exalted Paradise, and desire from the Sovereign of humankind. Indeed, they are among the greatest losers in the Book of God, the Lord of all worlds. He has come who was mentioned by the tongues of the chosen ones and recorded in the Books of God, the Lord of the mighty throne. Some people heard and denied; others heard and hastened until they attained the Kawthar of utterance and drank from it in His name, the Ever-Forgiving, the Generous. O people of Bahāʾ, listen to the call from the direction of the luminous Spot and the white Land. He truly summons you and gives you glad tidings of the loving care of God, the Sovereign of the Day of Judgment. Beware lest love of the world keep you from the Lord of humankind, or the insinuations of the heedless grieve you. Be so steadfast in the Cause that the doubts of the people of the Bayān, who turned away from the Truth when He came to them with manifest authority, cannot cause you to slip. By the life of God, they have not attained the Bayān or drunk the choice wine of recognition from the hands of the All-Merciful’s loving care, and they have denied Him for whose irrevocable and firmly established Cause they were created to serve. O people of the Bayān, by God, neither the books of the world nor the kingdom of names will benefit you today except through this Book, which speaks by night and day and gives everyone glad tidings of what is with God, the Most High, the Most Great. Thus has My Most Exalted Pen spoken, yet most people are heedless. Glory from Our presence rest upon those who have cast aside what people possess in the hope of what is with God. Indeed, they are among the firmly grounded. Praise be to God, the Lord of all worlds.

52

و هذا ما نزّل لجناب باقر ابن (ملّا) محمّد قبل علی قوله عزّ شأنه و جلّ بیانه

Wa-hādhā mā nuzzila li-janāb Bāqir ibn (Mullā) Muḥammad qabl ʿAlī, qawluhu ʿazza shaʾnuhu wa-jalla bayānuhu.

And this is what was revealed for Bāqir, son of (Mullā) Muḥammad before ʿAlī. His words—exalted is His station and glorious His utterance:

53

هو المشرق من افق العالم باسمه الأعظم

Huwa al-mushriq min ufuq al-ʿālam bi-smihi al-aʿẓam.

He is the One shining from the horizon of the world in His Most Great Name.

54

ذکر من لدنّا لمن اراد الوجه و انا الذّاکر العلیم قد ذکرنا الّذین آمنوا باللّه و اریناهم افقی الأعلی و اسمعناهم ندائی الأحلی و هدیناهم الی صراطی المستقیم یا اهل البهآء تاللّه الحقّ یذکرکم مولی الوری فی مقامه الأعلی الّذی سمّی بالسّجن مرّة و اخری بسمآء هذه السّمآء الّتی ارتفعت بأمری المهیمن علی من فی السّموات و الأرضین ان انصروا ربّکم الرّحمن بالأعمال و الأخلاق انّا امرناکم بها فی الواح نزّلت من سمآء مشیّة ربّکم العالم الخبیر یا باقر قد ذکرک عبد من عبادی الّذی طاف حولی و فاز بلقائی و شرب رحیق حبّی و اقتصر الأمور علی خدمة امری ذکرناک فضلاً من عندی و انا الفضّال الکریم ایّاک ان یمنعک شیء عن اللّه او تحجبک اشارات الغافلین الّذین یدّعون الایمان و جعلوا البیان شرکاً لأهل الایقان الا انّهم من الملحدین فی کتاب مبین قل خافوا اللّه و لا تدحضوا الحقّ بما عندکم ستفنی الدّنیا اذاً تجدون انفسکم فی خسران عظیم کذلک نطق لسان العظمة اذ کان القوم اکثرهم من الرّاقدین الأمواج الظّاهرة من بحر عنایتی علی الّذین ما نقضوا میثاق اللّه و عهده و طافوا حول امره البدیع

Dhikr min ladunnā li-man arāda al-wajh wa-anā al-Dhākir al-ʿAlīm. Qad dhakarnā alladhīna āmanū bi-Allāh wa-araynāhum ufuqī al-aʿlā wa-asmaʿnāhum nidāʾī al-aḥlā wa-hadaynāhum ilā ṣirāṭī al-mustaqīm. Yā ahl al-Bahāʾ, ta-Allāh al-Ḥaqq yadhkurukum Mawlā al-warā fī maqāmihi al-aʿlā alladhī summiya bi-al-sijn marratan wa-ukhrā bi-samāʾ hādhihi al-samāʾ allatī irtafaʿat bi-amrī al-muhaymin ʿalā man fī al-samāwāt wa-al-araḍīn. An inṣurū rabbakum al-Raḥmān bi-al-aʿmāl wa-al-akhlāq. Innā amarnākum bihā fī alwāḥ nuzzilat min samāʾ mashīʾat rabbikum al-ʿĀlim al-Khabīr. Yā Bāqir, qad dhakaraka ʿabd min ʿibādī alladhī ṭāfa ḥawlī wa-fāza bi-liqāʾī wa-shariba raḥīq ḥubbī wa-iqtaṣara al-umūr ʿalā khidmati amrī. Dhakarnāka faḍlan min ʿindī wa-anā al-Faḍḍāl al-Karīm. Iyyāka an yamnaʿaka shayʾ ʿan Allāh aw taḥjubaka ishārāt al-ghāfilīn alladhīna yaddaʿūna al-īmān wa-jaʿalū al-Bayān sharakan li-ahl al-īqān. Alā innahum min al-mulḥidīn fī kitāb mubīn. Qul khāfū Allāh wa-lā tudḥiḍū al-Ḥaqq bi-mā ʿindakum. Sa-tafnā al-dunyā idhan tajidūna anfusakum fī khusrān ʿaẓīm. Kadhālika naṭaqa lisān al-ʿaẓama idh kāna al-qawm aktharuhum min al-rāqidīn. Al-amwāj al-ẓāhira min baḥr ʿināyatī ʿalā alladhīna mā naqaḍū mīthāq Allāh wa-ʿahdahu wa-ṭāfū ḥawla amrihi al-badīʿ.

A remembrance from Our presence for whoever has desired the Face, and I am the Rememberer, the All-Knowing. We have remembered those who believe in God, shown them My most exalted horizon, caused them to hear My sweetest call, and guided them to My straight path. O people of Bahāʾ, by God, the Truth, the Lord of humankind remembers you in His most exalted station, which has been called at one time the Prison and at another the heaven of this heaven that has been raised by My command, which holds sway over all who are in the heavens and the earths. Aid your Lord, the All-Merciful, through deeds and character. We have enjoined these upon you in Tablets sent down from the heaven of the will of your Lord, the All-Knowing, the All-Informed. O Bāqir, a servant among My servants has mentioned you—one who has circled around Me, attained My presence, drunk the choice wine of My love, and confined his affairs to the service of My Cause. We have remembered you as a grace from Me, and I am the Most Bountiful, the Generous. Beware lest anything keep you from God, or the insinuations of the heedless veil you—those who claim belief and have made the Bayān a snare for the people of certitude. Indeed, they are among the unbelievers in a clear Book. Say: Fear God, and do not seek to refute the Truth with what you possess. The world will pass away; then you will find yourselves in grievous loss. Thus has the Tongue of Grandeur spoken while most people were asleep. May the waves rising from the ocean of My loving care be upon those who have not broken God’s covenant and pledge and have circled around His wondrous Cause.

55

و هذا ما نزّل لمن سمّی بحسین (عطّار) علیه ٩ ٦٦ [بهآء اللّه] قوله تبارک و تعالی

Wa-hādhā mā nuzzila li-man summiya bi-Ḥusayn (ʿAṭṭār) ʿalayhi 9 66 [bahāʾ Allāh], qawluhu tabāraka wa-taʿālā.

And this is what was revealed for the one named Ḥusayn (ʿAṭṭār), upon him be 9 66 [the glory of God]. His words—blessed and exalted is He:

56

بنام یکتا خداوند بیمانند

Be-nām-e yaktā Khodāvand-e bīmānand.

In the name of the one, incomparable God.

57

یا حسین بمحبّت الهی و شعلهٴ نار مودّت رحمانی بر خدمت امر قیام نما امروز هر نفسی ارادهٴ نصرت نماید باید از ما عنده بگذرد و به ما عند اللّه ناظر باشد یا حسین امروز دریای کرم موّاج و اشراقات انوار آفتاب جود کلّ وجود را احاطه نموده هر نفسی للّه برخاست قعود او را نبیند و توقّف او را اخذ نکند بجنود بیان بروح و ریحان گمراهانرا هدایت نماید و ضعیفانرا قوّت بخشد از اینکلمهٴ علیا نفسی تعجّب ننماید ابن مریم علیه سلام اللّه و سلام انبیائه صیّادی را ملاحظه فرمود که بصید ماهی مشغول فرمود دام را بگذار و بیا تا ترا صیّاد انام نمایم بعد از اینکلمه کلیل بود نطق یافت جاهل بود ببحر علم درآمد فقیر بود بملکوت غنا راه یافت ذلیل بود قصد ذروهٴ عزّت نمود گمراه بود بانوار فجر هدایت فائز گشت چه که از خود گذشت و بحقّ پیوست آمال را بنار حبّ سوخت و حجبات را باصبع یقین شقّ نمود تا در دنیا بود بیاد روح اللّه ناطق و چون میل عقبی نمود بمقامی فائز که اقلام عالم از ذکرش عاجز طوبی از برای نفوسیکه الیوم شبهات معرضین و اشارات منکرین و ضوضاء اهل بیان ایشانرا از مقصود امکان منع ننمود امروز روز استقامت است و روز خدمت جهد نمائید که شاید فائز شوید بآنچه که لدی اللّه مذکور و در کتاب مسطور البهآء علیک و علی کلّ ثابت مستقیم انتهی

Yā Ḥusayn, be-maḥabbat-e ilāhī va shoʿle-ye nār-e mavaddat-e raḥmānī bar khedmat-e amr qiyām namā. Emrūz har nafsī erāde-ye noṣrat namāyad bāyad az mā ʿendahu bog dharad va be mā ʿinda Allāh nāẓer bāshad. Yā Ḥusayn, emrūz daryā-ye karam mavvāj va eshrāqāt-e anvār-e āftāb-e jūd koll-e vo jūd rā eḥāṭe namūde. Har nafsī li-llāh barkhāst qoʿūd ū rā nabīnad va tavaqqof ū rā akhdh nakonad. Be-jonūd-e bayān be-rūḥ o rayḥān gomrāhān rā hedāyat namāyad va żaʿīfān rā qovvat bakhshad. Az īn kaleme-ye ʿolyā nafsī taʿajj ob nanamāyad. Ibn-e Maryam, ʿalayhi salāmu Allāh wa salāmu anbiyāʾihi, ṣayyādī rā molāḥeẓe farmūd ke be-ṣayd-e māhī mashghūl. Farmūd dām rā bog dhār va biyā tā to rā ṣayyād-e anām namāyam. Baʿd az īn kaleme kalīl būd noṭq yāft, jāhel būd be-baḥr-e ʿelm darāmad, faqīr būd be-malakūt-e ghenā rāh yāft, dhalīl būd qaṣd-e dh erve-ye ʿezzat namūd, gomrāh būd be-anvār-e fajr-e hedāyat fāʾez gasht, che ke az khod go dhasht va be-Ḥaqq peyvast. Āmāl rā be-nār-e ḥobb sūkht va ḥojobāt rā be-eṣbaʿ-e yaqīn shaqq namūd. Tā dar donyā būd be-yād-e Rūḥuʾllāh nāṭeq va chon meyl-e ʿoqbā namūd be-maqāmī fāʾez ke aqlām-e ʿālam az dhekrash ʿājez. Ṭūbā az barā-ye nofūsī ke al-yawm shobohāt-e moʿreżīn va eshārāt-e monkerīn va żawżā-ye ahl-e Bayān īshān rā az maqṣūd-e emkān manʿ nanamūd. Emrūz rūz-e esteqāmat ast va rūz-e khedmat. Jahd namāyīd ke shāyad fāʾez shavīd be-ānche ke ladā Allāh madhkūr va dar ketāb masṭūr. Al-Bahāʾu ʿalayka wa ʿalā kulli thābitin mustaqīm. Intahā.

O Ḥusayn, arise to serve the Cause with divine love and the flame of the fire of the All-Merciful’s affection. Today, whoever wishes to render assistance must relinquish what he possesses and look to what is with God. O Ḥusayn, today the ocean of generosity is surging, and the radiance of the sun of bounty has encompassed all existence. Whoever arises for God will never be seen sitting idle, nor will hesitation seize him. With the hosts of utterance, let him guide the wayward with joy and delight and strengthen the weak. Let no one be astonished at this exalted word. The Son of Mary, upon him be the peace of God and the peace of His Prophets, saw a fisherman occupied in catching fish. He said, “Put down the net and come, so that I may make you a fisher of humanity.” After these words, though tongue-tied, he gained speech; though ignorant, he entered the ocean of knowledge; though poor, he found his way to the kingdom of wealth; though abased, he set his sights on the summit of glory; though astray, he attained the light of the dawn of guidance. For he renounced himself and joined himself to God. He burned his desires in the fire of love and tore the veils apart with the finger of certitude. As long as he was in this world, he spoke in remembrance of the Spirit of God, and when he turned toward the world beyond, he attained a station that the pens of the world are powerless to describe. Blessed are those souls whom neither the doubts of those who turn away, nor the insinuations of the deniers, nor the clamor of the people of the Bayān have prevented today from reaching the Desire of all existence. Today is the day of steadfastness and the day of service. Strive, so that you may attain what is mentioned in God’s presence and inscribed in the Book. Glory be upon you and upon everyone who is firm and steadfast. End.

58

این فضل اعظم را نه ببحور میتوان تشبیه نمود و نه بامطار و نه باوراق اشجار و نه برمول صحرا و نه بذرّات کائنات آیا عباد مقبلین و موحّدین و مخلصین چگونه از عهدهٴ شکر برآیند نعمتیکه احصاء آن مشکل است شکر آنهم البتّه فوق عرفان بشر است چون فضلش و رحمتش سبقت یافت اذن عطا فرمود و این سبب بزرگ و علّة اعظم شد از برای ذاکرین و مخلصین و موحّدین والّا مقام خاک کجا و روح پاک کجا چه مناسبت چه مشابهت چه مشاکلت معدوم صرفیم و باراده‌اش موجود هر نفسی را آنمحبوب ذکر نمود بفیوضات نامتناهی فائز گشت مخصوص هر یک بحری از آیات جاری این خادم فانی از حقّ میطلبد مذکورین را تأیید فرماید بر آنچه امروز شایسته و پسندیده است

Īn fażl-e aʿẓam rā na be-boḥūr mītavān tashbīh namūd va na be-amṭār va na be-avrāq-e ashjār va na be-romūl-e ṣaḥrā va na be-dharrāt-e kāʾenāt. Āyā ʿebād-e moqbelīn va movaḥḥedīn va mokhleṣīn chegūne az ʿohde-ye shokr barāyand? Neʿmatī ke eḥṣā-ye ān moshkel ast shokr-e ān ham albatte fawq-e ʿerfān-e bashar ast. Chon fażlash va raḥmatash sebqat yāft edhn ʿaṭā farmūd va īn sabab-e bozorg va ʿellat-e aʿẓam shod az barā-ye dhākerīn va mokhleṣīn va movaḥḥedīn. Va-ellā maqām-e khāk kojā va rūḥ-e pāk kojā? Che monāsebat, che moshābahat, che moshākelat? Maʿdūm-e ṣerfīm va be-erāde-ash mawjūd. Har nafsī rā ān Maḥbūb dhekr namūd be-foyūżāt-e nāmotanāhī fāʾez gasht. Makhṣūṣ-e har yek baḥrī az āyāt jārī. Īn khādem-e fānī az Ḥaqq mīṭalabad madhkūrīn rā taʾyīd farmāyad bar ānche emrūz shāyeste va pasandīde ast.

This supreme grace cannot be likened to oceans, nor to rains, nor to the leaves of trees, nor to the sands of the desert, nor to the atoms of creation. How can His servants who turn toward Him, acknowledge His oneness, and are sincere discharge their duty of gratitude? A bounty that is difficult to enumerate is certainly also beyond human understanding to thank Him for. Since His grace and mercy took precedence, He granted permission, and this became a great means and a supreme cause for those who remember Him, are sincere, and acknowledge His oneness. Otherwise, how far apart are the station of dust and the pure Spirit! What relationship, what resemblance, what likeness is there? We are sheer nonexistence, brought into being by His will. Every soul whom that Beloved mentioned attained boundless outpourings of grace. For each one in particular, an ocean of verses flows. This transient servant asks God to assist those mentioned in doing what is fitting and acceptable today.

59

و اینکه در بارهٴ اولیای ن‌ی علیهم بهآء اللّه از ذکور و اناث ذکر نمودند و همچنین ذکر نفوسیکه بادای حقوق فائز گشتند کل در ساحت امنع اقدس اعلی عرض شد و هر یک بذکر مقصود عالمیان فائز و باشراقات انوار آفتاب فضل مزیّن قوله جلّ جلاله و عمّ نواله

Va īnke dar bāre-ye awliyā-ye Nūn-Yāʾ, ʿalayhim bahāʾu Allāh, az dhokūr va enāth dhekr namūdand va hamchenīn dhekr-e nofūsī ke be-adā-ye Ḥoqūq fāʾez gashtand, koll dar sāḥat-e amnaʿ-e aqdas-e aʿlā ʿarż shod va har yek be-dhekr-e Maqṣūd-e ʿālamiyān fāʾez va be-eshrāqāt-e anvār-e āftāb-e fażl mozayyan. Qawluhu jalla jalāluhu wa ʿamma nawāluhu.

What you mentioned concerning the friends in Nūn-Yāʾ, upon them be the glory of God, both men and women, and likewise your mention of those souls who attained the privilege of paying the Ḥuqūq, was all presented at the most exalted, most holy, most inaccessible Court. Each one was favored with mention by the Desire of all worlds and adorned with the radiance of the sun of grace. His words—exalted be His glory and all-embracing His bounty:

60

هو النّاظر من افقه الأعلی

Huwa al-nāẓiru min ufuqihi al-aʿlā.

He is the One who watches from His most exalted horizon.

61
